Western Suburbs: counsellors cluster Bandra East to Borivali along the Western Line.
Central and Eastern Suburbs: JVLR, the SCLR and the Eastern Freeway set the timings.
Navi Mumbai and Thane: experienced counsellor online, subject tutor in person.

sections.heading: How the Mumbai school year collides with application season
paragraphs: The collision is structural and every DP2 family in this city meets it. Application work for most systems runs through the same autumn and winter months in which DP2 internal assessments are set, the Extended Essay reaches submission and the first serious mock examinations arrive. Nothing about that is anyone's fault and nothing about it can be negotiated away. It can only be planned around, which means the system decision has to be made in DP1 rather than discovered in September of DP2.

School processes differ and you need yours specifically. Gopi Birla Memorial School in Walkeshwar, Activity High School on Peddar Road, Podar International School in Santacruz, JBCN International School, Oshiwara and JBCN International School, Borivali each run their own counselling arrangements, reference processes and internal deadlines for requesting documents. Ask your school when it needs a request by, what it will and will not send on a student's behalf, and when predicted grades are issued. Get the dates from the school rather than from a general calendar.

These schools are named as local context for families comparing areas and calendars. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any of them or with any university, and a counsellor we match has no standing in a school's reference, its predicted grades or any institution's decision. Where an outside counsellor and a school counsellor disagree, the school holds the process and the outside view is advice. Families who forget that order create work for themselves at the worst time of year.

Application calendars themselves are published by the systems and the institutions and they change between cycles, so take every date from the official source for the year your daughter is applying in. The one piece of Mumbai-specific planning worth doing early is the testing question: where standardised tests are sat, how far in advance seats are taken, and how a test date interacts with the school's own mock examination week. Ask the school whether it will release a student for a test sitting before assuming it will.
bullets: Application season overlaps DP2 assessments, the Extended Essay and mocks.
Ask your school for reference lead times and predicted-grade dates in writing.
A school counsellor owns the process; an outside counsellor gives advice.
Take every deadline from the official source for your child's own cycle.
Check test seat availability and whether school will release her for a sitting.

sections.heading: Do you need home tuition in Mumbai for admissions work, or online?
paragraphs: Split it by task and the question answers itself. Drafting and shortlisting work best in person, because an essay is improved by a conversation in which somebody asks a student what she actually meant and waits through the silence. An IB home tutor in Mumbai sitting at the table with a printed draft and a pen gets further in an hour than a shared screen does in two, and a printed draft is also harder to quietly abandon than an open document.

Interview rehearsal and anything scheduled by an institution in another time zone belong online, and there is no reason to pretend otherwise. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can run a mock interview at the awkward hour the real one will fall at, record it, and review it the next evening. Rehearsing at 9pm for an interview that will happen at midnight tests the wrong thing. Online also reaches the counsellor who has completed cycles in your specific system, which matters more than proximity for this work.

The pattern that holds for most families looking for IB university admissions guidance in Mumbai is a hybrid with a clear division: in-person sessions for the writing and the decisions, online for rehearsal, information sessions and anything that has to happen late. Review the split after the first drafts are done rather than at the start, because most students need more in-person time on writing than they or their parents expect.

Honest trade-offs. Home tutoring costs travel and limits how many appointments one counsellor can hold in an evening, which shows up in both availability and rate. Online loses the paper, and paper is genuinely useful for essay work. Hybrid asks a family already running subject tuition to hold a third kind of appointment through the busiest term of the Diploma. Protect the in-person drafting slots first and let everything else move.
bullets: In person for drafting and decisions, because paper and silence both help.
Online for interview rehearsal, at the hour the real interview will fall.
Online reaches counsellors with completed cycles in your specific system.
Home tutoring costs travel and limits a counsellor's evening appointments.
Protect the in-person drafting slots and let the rest move around them.

sections.heading: Who should you let advise on an application, and who should you not?
paragraphs: Identity documents, qualifications and work history are verified before a profile reaches you, and for admissions support we check the thing that matters most: completed cycles. Someone who has taken students from shortlist to decision has watched what goes wrong and when. Someone who has read a lot about admissions has not. The profile states how many cycles and in which systems, with dates, because a system's process can change substantially within a few years and advice from an old cycle can be confidently wrong.

Parents looking for the best IB tutor in Mumbai will find plenty of people who also offer admissions help, and the overlap is worth treating carefully. A superb Chemistry tutor commenting on a personal statement is doing a favour, not providing a service. Ask directly: how many applications have you worked on in this system, what did the last one get wrong, and what would you refuse to do. An honest answer to the third question is the single best signal available.

There are things nobody should be willing to do. A counsellor should not write any part of the application in the student's voice, should not contact a university on the family's behalf without the school's knowledge, and should not quote a requirement without naming where it is published. Be wary of anyone who offers a guaranteed admission or implies influence over an outcome, and of anyone who discourages you from checking their claims against the institution's own site. An IB private tutor Mumbai families trust with this work usually volunteers the official link before you ask.

IB Gram does not guarantee grades and cannot guarantee any admissions outcome, because no honest party can. What this work can do is make a decision early, keep the file coherent, and make sure every requirement acted on was read from the source that publishes it. The second of those saves families from the most common and most expensive error in the whole process, which is acting on a requirement that was true three cycles ago.
bullets: Completed cycles, with systems and dates, is the qualification that matters.
A strong subject tutor commenting on an essay is doing a favour, not a service.
Ask what the last application got wrong and what they would refuse to do.
Nobody should quote a requirement without naming where it is published.
Be wary of anyone offering a guaranteed admission or implying influence.

sections.heading: IB university admissions guidance in Mumbai: which system should you build around?
paragraphs: Everything else in IB university admissions guidance in Mumbai sits downstream of one choice: which application system the next two years are organised around. It is a real fork rather than a formality, because the systems ask for different work on different timetables. Some require a student to name a course at the point of application, which rewards a student who already knows her field and penalises one still deciding. Others ask for broad written work and a wider file, which rewards a student with range and penalises a narrow specialist. A third set runs on examination performance alone and asks for almost no file at all. Two things decide which suits your household: how settled the field is, and what the budget ceiling actually is.

Work out the money before anything else, and work it out as a number rather than a feeling. Costs differ enormously between systems and between institutions inside one system, funding routes differ, and the availability of support for international students is published by each institution and changes between cycles, so check each one's own current pages rather than trusting a summary. Families who leave this until DP2 routinely build a shortlist they cannot act on, and the student is the one who absorbs it. A plan made against a stated ceiling is smaller, calmer and almost always better executed.

The wrong reasons are easy to recognise and hard to resist. Choosing by ranking is the first: a ranking measures research output far more than it measures what an undergraduate experiences, and it says nothing about fit. Applying across every system to keep options open is the second and is the most damaging, because the work does not scale and five half-built applications read worse than two finished ones. Following a cousin's route is the third, and that cycle's rules may no longer apply. Choosing a system because your school is strong at it is the fourth, which is a reason to use the school's support, not a reason to pick the destination. And handing the decision to a consultant is the fifth: advice is purchasable, the decision is not.

Who owns what, and what is reversible. The student owns the field and the final list, because she will live in the place she is admitted to and nobody else will. Parents own the ceiling and should state it once, early, and in plain terms. The school counsellor owns references, predicted grades and the official process. Reversibility is generous in DP1 and shrinks quickly: narrowing a set is easy at any point, while adding a system late means new tests, new writing and a new reference request in the term when everything else is due. The genuinely locked items are a sat test score, a submitted application and a reference already written. IB tuition fees in Mumbai for this work follow the same shape, since counselling is usually priced around a set of applications rather than by the hour, and a system added in DP2 is charged as new work because that is what it is.
bullets: Systems differ in whether a course must be named at application.
Set the budget ceiling as a number in DP1, not as a feeling in DP2.
Applying across every system produces five half-built files, not more options.
Rankings measure research output, not what an undergraduate experiences.
Narrowing stays cheap; adding a system in DP2 is new work at the worst time.

sections.heading: What four weeks, one term and one cycle of admissions work should produce
paragraphs: Four weeks in, the deliverable is a document, not a feeling. You should have one page naming the system or systems being built around, the stated budget ceiling, the field, and the two or three things the student will do in DP1 to make the file coherent. If four sessions have produced enthusiasm and no page, the engagement is not working and this is the moment to say so, because the cost of saying it later is measured in a wasted DP1.

One term in, the test is whether the work has started rather than whether it is finished. A first draft of the main piece of writing should exist in her own voice, however rough. Any required test should be booked rather than discussed. The school's reference process should have been asked about in writing and the answer kept. A student who has a draft she dislikes is in a far better position than one with a polished plan and nothing written.

Across a full cycle, a well-run process looks quiet. A small set of applications, each finished properly, with the school's documents requested in time and no system bolted on in December. Things still go wrong for reasons nobody chose: a test sitting is cancelled, an institution changes a requirement mid-cycle, an illness takes out the fortnight a draft was due in. Where a counsellor earns the money is in rebuilding the sequence around what is left, quickly and without drama.

The limits, stated once and meant. Nobody can predict an admissions decision, and IB Gram does not guarantee grades or outcomes of any kind. What honest support produces is an early decision, a coherent file and requirements checked against their published source. If a counsellor is not working out, tell us in writing and we replace them, and the replacement starts from the existing one-page plan and the existing drafts rather than reopening the whole question.
bullets: Four weeks: one page naming system, ceiling, field and the DP1 actions.
One term: a rough draft in her voice, any test booked, reference process confirmed.
A draft she dislikes beats a polished plan with nothing written.
One cycle: a small set finished properly, with nothing added in December.
Replacement counsellors continue from the existing plan and drafts.

sections.heading: Starting home classes in Mumbai for the admissions plan
paragraphs: Bring four things to the first session: her current subjects and levels as the school has registered them, the predicted-grade and reference policy if you already have it, the field or two fields she is interested in, and the budget ceiling as a number. The last one is the one families want to leave until later and the one that changes the advice most. A counsellor who does not ask for it in the first hour is planning work you may not be able to use.

That first session is a decision session rather than a planning session. Expect the counsellor to narrow rather than expand, to ask your daughter what she would do with a year if nobody were watching, and to send you to at least two official pages to read before the follow-up. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai families already use can sit in usefully, because they know what she can actually produce under a deadline.

After the decision, the rhythm is short and frequent rather than long and occasional. Essay work improves across several short appointments with time to think between them, so a fixed weekday slot through the second half of DP1 does more than a block of long sessions in DP2. Home classes at a fixed early evening survive the term; anything that moves weekly is the first thing dropped when internal assessment deadlines land.

Two practical notes for Mumbai households. Register the counsellor at your society office as a standing weekly visitor so the start of each short session is not lost at the gate. And for the online half, agree in advance who in the household gives up the quiet room at eleven at night, because an interview rehearsal in a flat where nobody has planned for it fails for reasons that have nothing to do with the student.
bullets: Bring registered subjects and levels, the school's reference policy and a budget number.
The first session narrows the set and sends you to official pages to read.
Short frequent appointments beat long occasional ones for essay work.
Fix an early-evening weekly slot through the second half of DP1.
Plan who gives up the quiet room for a late online interview rehearsal.

faqs.question: When should we start admissions planning?
faqs.answer: Early in DP1, and the reason is sequencing rather than panic. The system decision changes which tests are needed, which writing has to be produced and which discretionary academic work is worth steering, and all of that is cheap to arrange in DP1 and expensive in DP2. Starting early does not mean applying early. It means the autumn of DP2 is spent finishing a plan rather than making one while internal assessments and mock examinations are already live.

faqs.question: Can a counsellor come to our home in Mulund for evening drafting sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes, and drafting is exactly the part worth having in person. In the Eastern Suburbs a counsellor based around Mulund, Bhandup or Vikhroli travels on the Central Line or the Eastern Express Highway without losing the session to the road, while one coming from the Western Suburbs usually will. Ask for the travel origin at the shortlist stage. If the experienced counsellor for your system lives further away, use them online and keep a local person for the in-person writing work.

faqs.question: Should we apply across several systems to keep our options open?
faqs.answer: Usually no, and this is the most common expensive mistake. Each system asks for different writing, different tests and sometimes a different reference, and the work does not scale, so a family spreading across four systems typically submits four weak files instead of two strong ones. Choose one primary system and at most one secondary, decided in DP1. If you genuinely need breadth, buy it by applying to a wider range of institutions within one system rather than across systems.

faqs.question: How much does admissions support cost in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: IB university admissions guidance in Mumbai is normally priced around a set of applications rather than by the hour, which makes comparing quotes harder than it looks. The variables are how many systems are involved, whether interview rehearsal and test strategy are included, and how much writing support is in scope. Ask each counsellor what happens if you add a system later, because that is the clause families meet in DP2. Also ask what is explicitly excluded, since exclusions tell you more than inclusions.

faqs.question: Our daughter does not know what she wants to study. Does that rule out some systems?
faqs.answer: It makes some systems a better fit than others, which is useful information rather than a problem. Systems that require a named course at the point of application suit a settled student; systems that read a broader file and allow a later choice suit one still deciding. Check how each institution and system actually handles this in its own current published guidance, because the detail differs. An undecided student is common and the right route for her exists.

faqs.question: Can anyone tell us what grades a particular university will require?
faqs.answer: Only that university can, through its own current published entry requirements, and anyone quoting you a figure from memory is risking your daughter's year. Requirements differ by course within the same institution and change between admission cycles. The right process is to read the official page for the specific course and cycle, note the date you read it, and confirm anything ambiguous with your school counsellor. We will send you to the source rather than summarising it for you.

faqs.question: How do we handle interviews scheduled in the middle of the Mumbai night?
faqs.answer: Rehearse at the actual hour, at least twice. An interview at one in the morning is a different physical task from the same interview at seven in the evening, and students who practise only at comfortable times are surprised by how much slower they think. Plan the room, the connection and who in the household is awake. Ask the institution whether alternative slots exist for applicants in this time zone, because some offer them and almost nobody thinks to ask.

faqs.question: Does the Extended Essay matter to admissions?
faqs.answer: It can, and how much is a question for each institution's published guidance rather than for a general rule. What is reliably true is that it is often the only substantial independent research a school-age applicant has produced, which makes it useful material for written work and for interviews regardless of how formally it is weighed. A student who can talk for ten minutes about what her research got wrong is demonstrating something no transcript shows.

faqs.question: Our society in Kharghar is far from any counsellor. What is the realistic setup?
faqs.answer: An experienced counsellor online and a local tutor in person, which is the standard arrangement across Navi Mumbai. The pool of counsellors with completed cycles in a specific system is thin from Vashi down to Panvel, and insisting that everyone be local usually means trading experience for proximity on the one piece of work where experience matters most. Keep the in-person element for drafting and let the system expertise arrive over a call.

faqs.question: Can IB Gram influence an admissions decision or a predicted grade?
faqs.answer: No, and nobody honest will claim to. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school or university named here. Predicted grades are produced by your school under its own policy, references are written by your school, and admissions decisions belong to the institutions. What support can do is make the decision early, keep the file coherent, and verify every requirement against the page that publishes it.

faqs.question: Should we use a paid consultant as well as the school counsellor?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the test is whether they add something the school cannot. A school counsellor knows your daughter, owns the reference and the process, and is usually managing a large year group. An outside counsellor can add depth in one system and time for drafting. Where the two disagree, the school holds the process and you should resolve it with the school rather than around it. Never let an outside adviser contact a university without the school knowing.

ib-university-admissions-guidance.closingCta: Send her registered subjects and levels, the field she is interested in and a budget ceiling you would actually sign. Two counsellor profiles come back naming the systems they have completed cycles in. The first session narrows rather than expands: one system chosen, a one-page plan, two official pages to read, and the three things worth doing in DP1 to make the file read as one person.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram turn a demo request into a matched tutor in Mumbai?
paragraphs: A demo request becomes a scheduled session in five steps: you send the board, the year group, the subject and the locality; IB Gram shortlists tutors who already teach that syllabus in that part of the city; one tutor and one slot are confirmed by name; the tutor asks you for the student's recent marked work; and the session then runs with that work already on the table. The shortlist step is where the usefulness comes from, and the material step is where the hour stops being a sales call.

1. Send the specifics in one message: board and programme, the exact year group, the subject with its level, your locality and the two weekday evening windows that genuinely work every week in your household. 2. Read the shortlist. Each tutor comes with the syllabus they actually teach and the travel radius they will hold to for a standing weekly slot. 3. Confirm one tutor and one slot, then send ahead the last marked script, the current coursework draft and the three things the student is stuck on. 4. Hold the session at the agreed time, with the material out, the table clear and the room quiet. 5. Write down your decision within two days, while you still remember what the hour showed rather than how it felt.

Most families who book an IB Gram book demo class in Mumbai send three lines and expect the rest to be worked out on the doorstep. Help with Maths, Grade 10, Andheri is not a brief. Which board, which tier, which paper, which teacher comment keeps repeating on the scripts: those five answers are what let a coordinator separate a tutor who teaches International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) Mathematics 0580 Extended from one who teaches Diploma Programme (DP) Mathematics Applications and Interpretation. The two people are not interchangeable and a demo cannot fix the mismatch once the tutor is at your gate.

What a tutor does with pre-sent material is the whole argument for sending it. Give a tutor a Chemistry Internal Assessment draft from a DP1 student in Chembur on Friday and by Monday evening they arrive knowing the design criterion is the weak one, that the research question is still too broad and that the student has never been shown what a controlled variable table should look like. Give the same tutor nothing and the first forty minutes go to finding out what you already knew. The matching work is only half the job; the preparation is the half families control, and it is the one that decides whether a first session of home tuition tells you anything.
bullets: Send board, year, subject, level and locality in your first message
Name two evening windows that work every week, not only this week
Attach the most recent marked script before the slot is confirmed
Write three stuck points in the student's own words, not yours
Ask each shortlisted tutor to state their travel radius in writing
Confirm the building name, tower and flat number, not just the area

sections.heading: Pin down the programme and level before the demo, not during it
paragraphs: The most common waste in a first session is its first twenty minutes. A tutor who arrives in Bandra West without knowing whether the student sits Middle Years Programme (MYP) 5 or IGCSE Year 10 spends that time establishing it, out loud, with a fourteen-year-old who is not sure either. Write the programme down once in plain words, send it ahead, and the hour starts at the actual problem instead of at the admin.

The ladder a Mumbai family is somewhere on: the Primary Years Programme (PYP) through the early years, where there are no exams and the demo is really about reading, number sense and written expression; the MYP from roughly Year 6 to Year 10, assessed against four criteria per subject and reported on a one to eight scale that parents consistently misread as a percentage; and the two-year Diploma Programme from Year 11, with three Higher Level (HL) and three Standard Level (SL) subjects plus the core of Theory of Knowledge (TOK), the Extended Essay (EE) and Creativity, Activity, Service. On the Cambridge side, IGCSE papers come from Cambridge International Education or from Pearson Edexcel, and the syllabus code on the front of the past paper settles arguments faster than the school's name does.

Core and Extended in IGCSE Mathematics, and HL against SL in the Diploma, are the two decisions that most often bring a family to a demo without anyone saying so. A parent books a session about marks and what they actually need is somebody to look at a predicted grade sheet, a university subject requirement and the school's option blocks together. If that is your real question, say so when you request the session and bring those three documents. A tutor asked to diagnose Maths will diagnose Maths. A tutor told the family is deciding between Analysis and Approaches HL and Applications and Interpretation SL before the option deadline will use the hour completely differently.

Year-group labels differ across Mumbai schools, which is why the demo brief should carry both. Grade 9 and MYP 4 are the same children. Year 11 at one school is the first IGCSE examination year and the first Diploma year at another. Write it as the school writes it and then translate: Grade 11, DP1, May 2027 session. Three commas of effort removes an entire category of confusion from the first ten minutes.
bullets: Write the programme, year group and examination session in one line
Photograph the syllabus code on the front of a past paper
Bring the option block sheet if subject choice is the real question
State whether the board is Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel
Note which MYP criteria the school reported lowest last term
Say if the student is repeating a year or joined mid-programme

sections.heading: Which subject papers and criteria should the student put on the table?
paragraphs: Put out three things per subject: the most recent marked paper with the teacher comments still on it, the official criteria sheet or mark scheme for that paper, and the current Internal Assessment (IA) draft at whatever stage it has reached. Those three turn a conversation into a diagnosis. Everything else in the folder can stay in the folder.

For Mathematics, the paper structure decides what is worth showing. Analysis and Approaches and Applications and Interpretation both run a non-calculator Paper 1 and a calculator Paper 2, with an extra extended-response Paper 3 at Higher Level, and the marks a Mumbai student loses are rarely evenly spread: it is the unseen structured question, or the graphical display calculator work that was never taught properly, or method marks thrown away by writing no working. Bring the last unit test rather than the best one of the year. For the IGCSE Extended tier, Papers 2 and 4 of 0580 reward exactly the working-out habits that a demo can see in ten minutes if the script is in front of the tutor.

In the sciences, Physics, Chemistry and Biology share a shape: a multiple-choice Paper 1, a structured and data-analysis Paper 2, and the scientific investigation marked against criteria that most students have never read in full. The IGCSE 0625 alternative-to-practical paper is its own skill and its own pile of lost marks. For English A Language and Literature, bring the Paper 1 guided textual analysis with the comment about unsupported assertion on it, because that comment is the lesson. Economics at Higher Level carries the policy-focused Paper 3; Business Management carries a research project that lives or dies on its tools. Name the component, not the subject, and the tutor can prepare.

Coursework comes as it is. A TOK essay that is a prompt and one unconvincing paragraph, an EE that is a title and a reading list, an IA with a method and no data: all three are more useful to a tutor than a tidy final draft, because the hour can be spent on the decision the student is stuck at. The students who get least from a first session are the ones whose parents said bring nothing, we will see what he needs. He needs the thing he is avoiding, and the thing he is avoiding is in his bag.
bullets: One marked script per subject, comments and crossings-out intact
The printed criteria sheet or mark scheme for that exact component
The IA, EE or TOK draft at its real stage, however thin
A list of topics the school has already taught this term
The graphical display calculator, charged, for any Maths session
Past paper and session details, such as 0580 Paper 4, May 2025

sections.heading: Mumbai home tuition zones and the first visit, from the gate to the table
paragraphs: Coverage across Mumbai, Maharashtra is organised by zone because travel, not talent, decides whether a weekly slot survives a full term. In South Mumbai, families in Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Walkeshwar, Babulnath, Peddar Road, Worli and Fort are matched within the island, since a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers a short distance and still loses most of an hour to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals at seven in the evening. The Churchgate to Mumbai Central stretch of the Western Line, the Harbour Line out of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Metro Line 3 from Cuffe Parade towards Bandra Kurla Complex and the Coastal Road are the routes that make or break a SoBo slot. In the Western Suburbs, Bandra West, Khar West, Santacruz West, Juhu, Andheri West, Versova, Goregaon East, Malad, Kandivali East, Borivali and Dahisar East sit along the Western Express Highway, the Link Road, the Western Line and Metro Lines 1, 2A and 7, and matching along that spine works far better than matching across it.

The Central Suburbs run on the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali hanging off the Jogeshwari Vikhroli Link Road in between. Powai is the exception worth planning around: it is central and has no station of its own, so tutors reach Hiranandani Gardens and Chandivali by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar East, and a 6.30pm start there is a different proposition from a 5pm one. Kurla is tied to everything by the Santacruz Chembur Link Road. In the Eastern Suburbs, Chembur, Govandi, Vikhroli, Bhandup, Wadala and Mulund West are served by the Central and Harbour lines, and the Eastern Freeway brings South Mumbai tutors within reach of Chembur and Wadala far faster than the map suggests.

Navi Mumbai is planned in nodes, so Vashi, Nerul, Seawoods, Belapur, Kharghar, Airoli and Panvel are matched node to node along Palm Beach Road and the Sion Panvel Highway, with the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines and the Belapur to Pendhar metro filling the gaps. The Atal Setu has made a Chembur or Wadala tutor plausible for a weekend Kharghar slot, though rarely for a Tuesday at six. Thane spreads west to east from the station across Pokhran Road, Majiwada, Hiranandani Estate, Vartak Nagar, Ghodbunder Road and Kasarvadavali, and the Ghodbunder stretch sets the whole schedule: twenty minutes off-peak, close to an hour in the evening peak. Thane tutors cover Thane, and a Mulund tutor crossing over is the exception, not the plan.

Then there is the part nobody plans and everybody complains about afterwards: the first visit. An IB Gram book demo class in Mumbai fails at the gate more often than it fails at the table. Register the tutor's name and phone number with the society office or on the building app the day before, not when they are standing outside in the rain. Tell the security desk which flat and which tower, because the watchman in a large Thane or Kharghar complex will not call up on trust. Clear a real table with a chair on each side, put a plug point within reach of a laptop, and take the television out of earshot. For an online demo, test the connection at the same hour on the previous day, since the hour that matters is the evening hour when everybody in the tower is streaming.

sections.heading: When in the Mumbai school year is a demo actually worth booking?
paragraphs: Book in the first three weeks of a term, or in the week a marked assessment comes back. The two worst moments are the week before a submission deadline and the first week of study leave, because in both the only honest advice a tutor can give is triage, and triage is not a diagnosis. A demo exists to show you how somebody thinks about the student's work, and it needs a little calendar space around it.

The Mumbai international school year opens in June and July, which is when subject choices, new programmes and the first wobble of the Diploma all land at once. September and October bring the first real summative assessments and the first MYP criteria grades that mean anything. November and December are the heaviest block: Extended Essay and Internal Assessment deadlines stack up, IGCSE October and November results arrive, and the Diwali break is both the only clear fortnight and the one most families waste. January and February belong to the DP2 mock examinations and the TOK essay, March and April to study leave and finishing, and the May session itself closes the year. A student whose Physics IA draft is due the same fortnight as her TOK essay does not need a demo that week; she needed one in August.

Families here work to calendars set by schools such as Dhirubhai Ambani International School in Bandra Kurla Complex, the American School of Bombay, Ascend International School, Ecole Mondiale World School and Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, Oberoi International School on the Jogeshwari Vikhroli Link Road, Bombay International School at Babulnath, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, NES International School in Mulund West, the JBCN International School campuses at Parel and Chembur, Thakur International School in Kandivali East, Singapore International School in Dahisar East, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of these schools, with the International Baccalaureate organisation or with Cambridge International Education. Naming them here is calendar context and nothing more.

Bring the deadline calendar to the demo as a piece of paper, not as a memory. Two months of dates, with the submission days circled, changes what a tutor says in the last ten minutes of the hour: they will tell you which of the three stuck points can wait until December and which one has to move this week. That is the most valuable sentence a first session produces, and it is impossible to say without the calendar on the table.

sections.heading: Should the demo be a home class in Mumbai or an online session?
paragraphs: Choose a home class if the subject is handwriting-heavy or the student is younger than about fifteen, and choose an online session if the tutor whose subject expertise you want sits across the city. The two need different preparation. A home demo needs a gate pass, a table and a quiet hour. An online demo needs the marked script scanned and sent ahead, plus a camera angle that shows working, not a face.

Home tutoring is the lead service for a reason: an IB home tutor in Mumbai sitting at the same table can see the student's hand hesitate, can turn the script around and annotate it, and can tell within fifteen minutes whether the gap is knowledge, method or confidence. The honest trade-offs are travel and fragility. An IB home tuition slot in the Western Suburbs at 6pm competes with the Western Express Highway, a Thane slot competes with Ghodbunder Road, and monsoon weeks produce the cancellations that eventually end weekly arrangements. Travel distance also feeds directly into what you will be quoted, so a tutor matched three kilometres away is a more durable choice than a better-credentialled one matched across the creek.

An IB online tutor in Mumbai widens the pool to the person who actually teaches that HL option paper, and removes Peddar Road and the Sea Link from the equation entirely. The trade-offs are real: it is harder to read a reluctant fifteen-year-old through a screen, the student has to make their working visible rather than hiding it, and the Mumbai evening is when a tower's bandwidth is worst. Preparation is what closes most of that gap. Send a clear scan or photograph of the script the day before, set a second phone on a stand as a document camera pointing at the page, put the student at a table with the camera at eye level, and join the call five minutes early to find out that the microphone does not work before the hour starts rather than six minutes into it.

Hybrid is what most arrangements become by the second term, and the demo is a reasonable place to test it: one session at home each week for the subject that needs a shared page, one online for the subject that needs the specialist. Families booking all IB and IGCSE subjects in home classes across Mumbai usually find the mix settles by itself, with the handwriting-heavy work at the table and essay feedback done on a screen with a shared document. Decide the format of the demo on the basis of which question you are trying to answer, and say so when you book.
bullets: Home tuition at the table: gate pass, clear table, one quiet hour, phones away
Online demo: script scanned and sent ahead, second phone as a document camera
Test the link and the evening bandwidth on the previous day
Handwriting-heavy subjects read better at a shared table
Scarce HL option papers often mean the specialist is online
Pick the format that answers your question, not the easier one to arrange

sections.heading: What a good tutor asks you for before the demo, and what you should check
paragraphs: Before an IB Gram book demo class in Mumbai, a tutor worth keeping asks you for five things: the most recent marked script, the syllabus version and examination session, the stage the IA or EE has reached, what the school has actually covered this term, and what the student thinks is going wrong. A tutor who asks for nothing at all is a mild warning sign. It usually means one of two things: they intend to improvise the hour, or they teach the same first lesson to everybody and your child's script would not change it.

On IB Gram's side, verification is identity, qualification claims, subject and syllabus experience, teaching history and references, checked before a tutor appears on any shortlist. What no platform can verify is the part you are booking the demo to find out: whether this particular adult can hold the attention of this particular teenager in your dining room on a Wednesday evening. That is what the hour is for, and it is why the preparation matters more than the vetting paperwork.

Your own checks take about four minutes and are worth more than a résumé. Ask which syllabus version they teach and which papers they have marked or prepared students for. Ask them to read one criterion from the sheet you brought and say in plain words what the top band actually requires, because a tutor who paraphrases the criterion back at you without translating it has not used it much. Ask what they would do with the script in front of them over the next four weeks, specifically. And ask the practical question too: what do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on in their case, which should come back as board, level, subject scarcity, travel distance and session length, stated in writing rather than negotiated at the door.

Two housekeeping points that save arguments later. Have the tutor carry photo identification for the society gate, and keep every arrangement, slot, rate basis and cancellation rule in writing on the platform rather than in a verbal understanding at the end of a good first hour. Searching for the best IB tutor in Mumbai is the wrong frame anyway; what you want is the tutor who read your child's script before arriving and had something precise to say about it.
bullets: A tutor who requests nothing before the session has not prepared
Ask which syllabus version and which papers they have prepared students for
Have them translate one criterion band into plain English
Ask for a specific four-week plan for the script in front of them
Fee basis in writing: board, level, scarcity, travel, session length
Photo identification for the gate, and all arrangements kept on the platform

sections.heading: The hour before: a preparation checklist for an IB Gram book demo class in Mumbai
paragraphs: Five things on the table before the session starts: the most recent marked script with the teacher's comments still on it, the current IA or EE draft at whatever stage it has reached, the official criteria sheet for that piece of work, a written list of the three things the student is actually stuck on, and the school deadline calendar for the next two months. Nothing else. A folder containing everything from the year is as unhelpful as an empty table, because the tutor spends the hour sorting rather than teaching.

The phrase that costs families the most is we will see how it goes. It sounds open-minded and it hands the hour away. A tutor with no material in front of them improvises: a general chat about confidence, two textbook questions, a friendly summary at the door. You learn that the tutor is pleasant, which you could have learned on the phone. You do not learn whether they can read a comment on a Chemistry IA and tell a DP1 student exactly what the examiner wanted instead. The three stuck points are the step families skip and the step that changes the session most, and they have to be in the student's own words. I do not understand moles is a different problem from I can balance the equation but lose marks on significant figures, and only the second one can be fixed in the four weeks before a test.

Who should be in the room: the student and the tutor. One parent nearby for the first ten minutes and the last ten, and not for the fifty in between. The reason is practical rather than philosophical. A DP1 student in Andheri West will not say I have not started my Internal Assessment in front of a parent who believes it is half written, and a tutor who cannot get an honest answer in the first session will spend three weeks finding out what they could have known on day one. Siblings out of the room. Phones face down on the sideboard, including the parent's. If the doorbell is going to ring four times in that hour, tell the gate the slot is blocked. For an online demo, the student sits at a table with the camera on, not on a bed with the laptop balanced on their stomach and a parent narrating from the doorway.

The questions to ask when the hour ends are short and there are only three. What is the single biggest gap you saw today, in one sentence. What would the first four weeks look like, and what will you set for the student to do between sessions. What do you need from us, including the fee basis in writing and the slot you can actually hold through the term. The student gets one question of their own, and it is the most diagnostic question of the lot: can you show me how you would start the question I got wrong. If the tutor answers by explaining the answer rather than demonstrating the approach, write that down, because that is how every future session will go. Then write your own three lines within two days, while the hour is still fresh: what the tutor noticed, what the student could do at the end that they could not do at the start, and whether anybody said anything specific enough to be wrong about.
bullets: Marked script, coursework draft, criteria sheet, three stuck points, deadline calendar
Three stuck points written by the student, not translated by the parent
One parent for the first and last ten minutes, not the middle fifty
Siblings out, phones down, doorbell and television dealt with in advance
Parent asks three closing questions; the student asks one
Write your own three-line verdict within two days of the session

sections.heading: Judging the demo afterwards: liking a tutor is not learning from one
paragraphs: Two different questions come out of the same hour and families routinely answer only the first. Did my child like them. Did my child learn something in that hour. Liking matters, because a teenager who dreads Thursday at six will find a way to lose Thursday at six, but liking is not evidence. Evidence is narrow and easy to test: the student can do one thing at the end of the hour that they could not do at the start, and can tell you what it was without being prompted. If the answer is he was really nice and we talked about school, you have a rapport reading and no learning reading, and you should book a second conversation rather than a term.

A single session also has honest limits, and knowing them stops you over-reading it. One hour cannot tell you whether a tutor is consistent across eleven weeks, how they behave when the student plateaus in the fifth week, whether they will chase unfinished work or quietly let it go, whether they can run a timed paper under real pressure, or how they handle a bad mock result in January. It cannot tell you how the student will respond once the novelty wears off. Those things show up at four weeks and at a term, which is why the demo is a filter for the obviously wrong match rather than a verdict on the right one. A home tutor earns the judgement over a term, not over an hour.

What realistic progress looks like, said plainly: at four weeks you should see habit change, such as working shown, past paper questions attempted, drafts moving from nothing to something. At one term you should see the specific weaknesses in the marked scripts narrowing and a teacher comment that no longer repeats itself. Across a full examination cycle you should see the student's own judgement of their work improve, because that is what carries into the examination hall when nobody is sitting beside them. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no tutor who has read a syllabus honestly will promise one either. Outcomes depend on the student's work between sessions, the school's teaching and how early the support started.

How to say no gracefully, because most families handle this badly by doing nothing. Send one short message within two days. Thank the tutor for the session, say the fit is not right for your child, and stop there. No reasons are owed and a half-explained reason invites a negotiation you do not want. Do not go silent: the subject-specific tutor pool in any one Mumbai zone is not large, you may want this person for a different child or a different year, and the coordinator matching your replacement will work faster with a clear no than with a maybe. If the problem was the subject rather than the person, say that instead, and ask for a different tutor on the same syllabus.
bullets: Separate did my child like them from did my child learn something
Test: one thing the student can now do and can name unprompted
A demo cannot show consistency, plateau behaviour or exam-day nerves
Four weeks for habits, one term for narrowing weaknesses, one cycle for judgement
Say no in one short message within two days, with no reasons owed
If the subject was the mismatch, ask for a different tutor on the same syllabus

sections.heading: Booking an IB home tuition demo in Mumbai: what happens next?
paragraphs: After you send a query, a coordinator comes back with questions before tutors: board, programme, year group, subject and level, your locality and the evening windows that work. Then a shortlist of tutors who teach that syllabus in your zone, each with a stated travel radius. You pick one, a slot is confirmed by name, and the tutor contacts you for the student's recent work before the session rather than after it. Nobody turns up at your gate unannounced, and nothing is confirmed by a phone call you did not expect.

Your side of the twenty-four hours before: put the marked script, the coursework draft and the criteria sheet in one place, get the three stuck points written down by the student, print two months of school deadlines, register the tutor at the society gate, and clear a table. If the session is online, send the scan ahead and test the link at the same hour the day before. That is the whole preparation, and it takes less time than the arguing about it usually does.

The first ongoing session after a demo should look different from the demo itself. It starts from the gap the tutor named, it comes with work set for the week in between, and it ends with the student able to say what they are doing before the next session. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai parents ask about will not exist as one person, so expect a different tutor per subject and a short written plan for each. Ask for both in the same message you use to confirm.

Then set a review point at four weeks and keep it, in the diary, with the marked scripts from that month in front of you. Families who book an IB private tutor Mumbai coordinators matched for them and never look at the scripts again are the ones still asking in February whether it is working. The scripts answer that question. Parents typing IB tutors near me in Mumbai are usually looking for proximity; proximity keeps the slot alive, but the scripts are what tell you the hour is doing something.
bullets: Coordinator asks for specifics before any tutor is proposed
Shortlist carries syllabus taught and travel radius, not slogans
Tutor requests the student's recent work before the session
Expect a separate tutor per subject and a short written plan for each
Diary a four-week review with that month's marked scripts in hand

faqs.question: What exactly should my child have ready before the demo starts?
faqs.answer: Five items, on the table, before the tutor sits down: the most recent marked script with the teacher's comments intact, the current IA or EE draft at whatever stage it is in, the printed criteria sheet for that piece of work, a written list of the three things the student is stuck on, and two months of school deadlines on one page. Not a folder of the whole year, which only gets sorted rather than used. The three stuck points should be in the student's own words, because the wording tells a tutor whether the problem is knowledge, method or confidence.

faqs.question: Is a demo worth booking if we have not chosen subjects yet?
faqs.answer: Yes, but brief it as a subject-choice session rather than a tuition session, or the hour goes to the wrong question. Bring the school's option block sheet, the latest predicted or reported grades, and any university or course requirement you already know about. A tutor who understands HL against SL in the Diploma, or Core against Extended in IGCSE Mathematics, can tell you what each path demands week to week, which is the information missing from most option-form conversations. Say in your request that the decision deadline is coming, and give the date.

faqs.question: Who should be in the room during a home demo, and who should not?
faqs.answer: The student and the tutor, with one parent nearby for the first ten minutes and the last ten only. The middle of the hour needs the student to admit things they will not admit in front of you, starting with how little of the Internal Assessment actually exists. Siblings should be out of the room, the television out of earshot and phones face down, including yours. If you have domestic staff arriving or a delivery expected, deal with it in advance. For an online demo, the same rules apply with one addition: the student sits at a table with the camera on, not on a bed. Home tuition only works if the room is treated as a classroom for that hour.

faqs.question: What should I ask the tutor at the end of the demo?
faqs.answer: Three questions, and keep them short. What is the single biggest gap you saw today, in one sentence. What would the first four weeks look like, and what will you set between sessions. What do you need from us, including the fee basis in writing and the weekly slot you can hold all term. Your child gets one question of their own: can you show me how you would start the question I got wrong. If the answer explains the answer instead of demonstrating the approach, that is how every session will go, so note it now rather than in week five.

faqs.question: How do we get the tutor into our society in Powai on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Register the tutor the day before, not at the gate. Most Hiranandani Gardens and Chandivali complexes run a visitor app or an office register, and the security desk will not call up for an unlisted name however polite the conversation is. Give the tower and flat number, keep the tutor's number on your phone and send them yours. Powai has no railway station of its own, so tutors arrive by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar East using the Jogeshwari Vikhroli Link Road, which means a 6.30pm start is far more reliable than a 5pm one.

faqs.question: Our building is off Ghodbunder Road in Thane. How should we schedule the first visit?
faqs.answer: Schedule it later than feels natural and match within Thane. The Ghodbunder Road stretch between the station and Kasarvadavali takes twenty minutes off-peak and close to an hour in the evening peak, so a tutor coming from Pokhran Road or Majiwada for a 6pm slot will either be late or will leave home absurdly early and resent it by week three. Pick a Thane-based tutor, agree a 7pm start, register the name at the gate the day before, and keep the first session on a weekday you can actually repeat every week.

faqs.question: Does an online demo tell us as much as a home demo?
faqs.answer: It tells you less about rapport and almost as much about subject thinking, provided you prepare for it. Send a clear scan of the marked script the day before so the tutor is not squinting at a webcam. Set a second phone on a stand pointing at the page so the student's working is visible. Put the student at a table with the camera at eye level, join five minutes early and test the microphone. The genuine limits are reading a reluctant teenager through a screen and Mumbai evening bandwidth in a full tower, which is why you test at the same hour the day before.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on?
faqs.answer: Board and programme, the level, how scarce the subject is, how far the tutor travels and how long the session runs. A Higher Level option paper with few qualified teachers in your zone sits differently from a general MYP Mathematics requirement, and a tutor matched three kilometres away costs less in travel time than an equally good one across the creek. Ask for the basis in writing before you commit to a term, including what happens to a session you cancel late and a session the tutor cancels. Keep it on the platform rather than as a doorstep understanding.

faqs.question: What if the demo goes badly, or the tutor is simply not right?
faqs.answer: Say so within two days and ask for a different match on the same syllabus. One short message is enough and no reasons are owed, though if you can name the problem it makes the replacement faster: wrong level, too gentle with an avoidant student, strong on content and weak on the criteria. A coordinator can act on any of those. The thing that slows everything down is silence, because a maybe keeps a slot provisionally held and keeps the next tutor waiting. Nothing about a first session commits you to a term.

faqs.question: Can one session tell us whether our child will improve?
faqs.answer: No, and a tutor who says it can is telling you something useful about themselves. One hour can show whether somebody reads a mark scheme properly, explains a method rather than an answer, and can hold a teenager's attention at your table. It cannot show consistency over eleven weeks, how they handle a plateau in week five, whether they chase unfinished work, or what happens after a bad January mock. Those appear at four weeks and at one term. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and outcomes depend heavily on what the student does between sessions.

faqs.question: How do I say no to a tutor after the demo without being rude?
faqs.answer: One message, within two days, thanking them and saying the fit is not right for your child. Stop there. Giving a half-reason invites a negotiation and a counter-offer you did not want, and going silent is worse than either, because the tutor keeps your slot provisionally free. The subject-specific pool in any single Mumbai zone is not large, so you may want this person for a different child or a different year. A clear no also lets the coordinator start the replacement the same day rather than at the end of the week.

faqs.question: What happens if we miss the demo slot or need to reschedule?
faqs.answer: Message as early as you can and offer two alternative windows rather than asking the tutor to propose them. A tutor who has already left Santacruz West for a Borivali slot in monsoon traffic has lost the evening, and that is how a promising match quietly ends before it starts. Reschedules are routine when they come with notice; same-hour cancellations are the thing that makes tutors deprioritise a family. If the student is unwell, say so plainly and move the session rather than running an hour nobody can use.

ibgram-book-demo-class.closingCta: Send one message with the board, the year group, the subject and level, your locality and the two evening windows that work every week. A coordinator comes back with a shortlist of tutors who teach that syllabus in your zone, with travel radius stated. You confirm one tutor and one slot; the tutor then asks you for the student's recent marked work before the session. Spend the hour before getting those five items onto a cleared table, and the demo will actually be worth having.

sections.heading: What happens after you send an enquiry to IB Gram in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Your enquiry is read by a person, matched against tutors who already teach that board and that level, filtered by whether they can reach your address in the time slot you named, and returned to you as a short list with a reason attached to each name. There is no automated matcher and no public posting of your details.

The reading stage is where a detailed enquiry pays for itself. If the message names the board, the exact subject and level, the school, the locality and two workable evening windows, the shortlist can be drawn in the same sitting. If it says only that a child needs maths help somewhere in the Western Suburbs, the first reply is a list of questions, and the week you wanted to save goes on the questions instead. Nobody is being difficult: a Diploma Programme (DP) Higher Level (HL) Analysis and Approaches tutor and an International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) Core Mathematics tutor are different people, and a tutor who can be in Chembur at seven on a Tuesday is a different person again.

After the shortlist, you choose who to meet. A first session is a working session rather than an interview: the tutor looks at a returned paper, a marked internal assessment (IA) draft or a mock script, and tells you what they would do over the next six weeks. You then decide whether to continue. If the fit is wrong, say so and the match is redone from the same enquiry, which is another reason the enquiry is worth writing properly once.

An IB Gram contact in Mumbai costs you nothing at the enquiry stage and commits you to nothing. We do not promise a reply inside any fixed number of hours, because a genuine match in Panvel for a scarce subject takes longer to find than one in Powai.

sections.heading: Which board and programme should your enquiry name?
paragraphs: Name the board and the programme in the same breath: International Baccalaureate (IB) Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP) or Diploma Programme (DP), or IGCSE with the awarding body, which in Mumbai is usually Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. Those two words decide almost everything that follows.

The reason is that the boards are not interchangeable at the teaching level. An MYP Year 5 student is being marked against four criteria per subject with command terms that change what a full answer looks like; a DP2 student has papers, an IA and a grade boundary; a PYP child is inside a transdisciplinary unit and needs a tutor who will not turn it into a worksheet. IGCSE splits again into Core and Extended in Mathematics, and into pathways with different paper combinations elsewhere. A tutor who is fluent in Cambridge mark schemes may not know the Edexcel paper structure, and that mismatch shows up in the second week, not the first.

Transfers make this sharper. Mumbai families move between an IGCSE school and an IB DP school more often than families in most cities, and a student who has just arrived in DP1 from IGCSE Extended Mathematics is strong on technique and new to the inquiry-style questions and the IA. An IB home tutor in Mumbai who has taken students through that specific crossing is worth asking for by description of experience, not by name of school. Say in the enquiry which board the child is leaving and which one they are entering.

If you genuinely do not know the programme, write what the school calls the year group and write the school's name. That is enough for us to work it out, and it is far better than guessing a label that then steers the whole search wrongly.
bullets: Say IB PYP, MYP or DP, not just the school name.
For IGCSE, name Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel if known.

sections.heading: Which subject and level details does a Mumbai tutor need?
paragraphs: Write the subject, the level and the component you are worried about: Physics HL Paper 2, Mathematics Applications and Interpretation Standard Level (SL), IGCSE Chemistry Extended Paper 4, MYP Individuals and Societies Criterion C. Three words of detail there save a fortnight of the wrong teaching.

Level is not a formality. HL Chemistry carries the additional higher level material and a longer paper; SL Chemistry does not, and a tutor pitching HL depth at an SL student burns the hour on content that will never be examined. Mathematics is the clearest case: Analysis and Approaches and Applications and Interpretation are two different subjects that happen to share a name, and HL Analysis and Approaches is the one families most often underestimate. On the IGCSE side, Core caps the available grade and Extended does not, so a child sitting Extended Mathematics and a child sitting Core need different work even in the same classroom.

Then there is the internal assessment, which is where most late-year panic comes from. Every DP subject carries one: a Physics IA with its own uncertainty treatment, a History IA with a defined investigation structure, a Mathematics exploration, a Language A written task, plus the Extended Essay (EE) and the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay sitting outside any single subject. MYP has its criterion-based tasks and the personal project; IGCSE has coursework in some subjects and none in others. Tell us which one is due and whether a draft already exists, because a tutor booked for exam technique and then handed an IA draft is being asked to do a different job.
The form asks about all IB and IGCSE subjects a tutor in Mumbai may need to cover, because a surprising number of enquiries turn out to be two subjects rather than one.
bullets: Name the exact subject, the level, and the paper or criterion.
Mathematics: say Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation.
IGCSE: say Core or Extended, especially in Mathematics.
State which IA, EE or TOK task is due and when.
Say whether a draft already exists and has been marked.

sections.heading: How Mumbai geography decides which tutor can actually reach you
paragraphs: Write your locality, not your zone. Mumbai, Maharashtra is a city where eight kilometres can cost forty minutes, so a tutor is matched to an address, a time and a route, not to a region of the map.

In South Mumbai the distances are short and the signals are not: a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba or Cuffe Parade can lose the evening to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali queues, so island matches stay on the island, with Fort and Babulnath served from inside it rather than from the suburbs. The Western Suburbs run north to south along the Western Line and the Western Express Highway, which means Khar West to Santacruz West or Malad to Kandivali works and Bandra to Borivali at six in the evening does not. Juhu, Andheri West and Goregaon East are each quick to their neighbours and slow across the city.

The Central Suburbs sit on the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali hanging off JVLR and no station of their own, so a Powai tutor arrives by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar and the SCLR carries the Kurla to Chembur leg. The Eastern Suburbs run from Chembur and Govandi through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund, and the Eastern Freeway makes Wadala and Chembur closer to South Mumbai than the map suggests. Navi Mumbai is node to node: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel along Palm Beach Road and the Sion to Panvel highway, with the Atal Setu and the Trans-Harbour Line for the crossing. Thane spreads from the station along Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road, where Kasarvadavali at seven in the evening is a different journey from Kasarvadavali at three.

Metro Lines 1, 2A, 3 and 7 and the Bandra-Worli Sea Link have changed some of those numbers and left others exactly where they were, and the Harbour Line is what matters for Chembur, Govandi and Mankhurd. A search for IB tutors near me in Mumbai returns nothing useful without the locality, so give the building name, the gate the tutor should use, the floor, and whether there is a working lift.

sections.heading: Naming your school tells a Mumbai tutor your calendar
paragraphs: Write the school's name in the enquiry. It is the cheapest piece of information you can give, because it tells a tutor the board, the report cycle, the mock dates and the week the internal assessments land.

Mumbai's international schools do not share a calendar. Families at Dhirubhai Ambani International School in Bandra Kurla Complex, the American School of Bombay and Ascend International School in the same complex are on IB timelines; Ecole Mondiale World School and Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu run their own PYP, MYP and DP sequences; Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Bombay International School at Babulnath and B.D. Somani International School at Cuffe Parade set the South Mumbai pattern. Oberoi International School on JVLR, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, NES International School in Mulund West, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul each stamp a different rhythm on the same board.

The rhythm is what matters to a tutor's plan. A May-session DP2 cohort has mocks in the winter term, IA final deadlines clustered soon after, the Extended Essay (EE) viva in the same stretch and the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay upload on top. October to December is the heaviest stretch for DP2 across most Mumbai schools; February and March are mock and final-draft months; the monsoon weeks from June to August are when a new DP1 or Year 10 cohort first discovers the workload. A tutor who knows the school can tell you in the first session which of those pressure points you are standing in, and plan backwards from it.

To be plain about it: IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page. Naming a school in your enquiry is context for scheduling and syllabus, nothing more, and no tutor on a shortlist is presented as the representative of one.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid: which do you ask for?
paragraphs: Ask for home tuition if the child works better with someone in the room and you can hold a fixed weekday slot; ask for online if the subject is scarce or your evenings are unpredictable; ask for hybrid if you want the room for the hard sessions and a screen for the quick ones. State the preference, then state the fallback.

Home tuition is the lead service and the most common request. An IB home tutor in Mumbai sitting in your flat has the child's folder, the returned papers and the textbook in front of them, can see the handwriting that is costing method marks, and cannot be ignored while a phone is open on the table. The cost is logistics: a fixed slot, a gate pass, travel time at the tutor's end, and a session that moves if the Western Express Highway stops moving. IB home tuition in Mumbai holds together when the slot is the same day each week and the family protects it from everything else.

An IB online tutor in Mumbai solves the problems home tuition cannot. Scarce subjects, Higher Level Economics, Further Mathematics, a specific second language, sometimes have no local tutor on your side of the city at all, and a screen removes the travel question entirely. Online also survives exam season better, because a thirty-minute paper review at nine at night is reasonable online and absurd as a house call. The trade-offs are real: a younger PYP or MYP child drifts faster online, diagrams and working are harder to see, and a weak connection in the monsoon can cost half a session.

Hybrid is what most long-running arrangements quietly become: a weekly home session for teaching and a short online session before a deadline. An IB Gram contact in Mumbai that names a preference and a fallback gets a shortlist faster, because a tutor who is wrong for Tuesday at your flat may be exactly right for Sunday on a screen.
bullets: Say home, online or hybrid, and name your fallback option.
Home classes suit younger learners and handwriting-heavy subjects.

sections.heading: What IB Gram checks before a home tutor reaches your Mumbai address
paragraphs: Before a tutor is shortlisted, IB Gram checks identity, the qualifications claimed, the boards and levels they have actually taught, and references from previous teaching or tutoring. What we cannot check is whether they will work with your child, which is what the first session is for.

The practical checks are ordinary and worth stating. Government photo identity is verified against the name used on qualifications. Degree and teaching certificates are asked for in document form, not taken on description. Claimed experience is tested by subject and level: a tutor who says they teach Diploma Programme (DP) Higher Level Biology is asked which option they have taught, how they handle the IA, and what they do with a student who is losing method marks on Paper 2. References are contacted where previous families have agreed to be contacted. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai does not exist, and a tutor who claims to be one is a flag rather than a find.

Then there is what you should check yourself, because no platform substitutes for a parent in the room. Ask the tutor at the first session which syllabus edition they are teaching from and watch whether the answer is specific. Ask them to mark one of your child's existing answers in front of you and see whether the feedback names a criterion or a mark scheme line. Sit within earshot of the first two home sessions. Ask what the plan is for the next month and whether it is written down anywhere. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes in Mumbai follow the same pattern: the good ones are boring, specific and consistent.
None of this is a guarantee of outcome. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and anyone who does is selling you something a tutor cannot deliver.
bullets: Photo identity verified against the name on the qualifications.
Degrees and teaching certificates requested as documents, not descriptions.
Board and level experience tested with subject-specific questions.

sections.heading: A weak enquiry rewritten as a strong request for home tuition
paragraphs: Here is the real shape of most first enquiries: 'need maths tutor Bandra'. Four words. It cannot be matched, because it does not say which board, which level, which child, which year, or when anyone is free. The reply it earns is a list of questions, and the search starts a week late.

Rewritten, the same request looks like this. 'My daughter is in DP1 at a school in Bandra West, sitting the May 2027 session. Mathematics Analysis and Approaches Higher Level. She came from IGCSE Extended and did well there, but she lost most of the method marks on her first Paper 1 and has not started the exploration. We are in a building off Linking Road with lift access and a study room at home. Tuesday or Thursday between 6.30 and 8, home tuition preferred, online acceptable for a quick review before a deadline. We tried a group class in September and it did not hold her attention.' That is one paragraph, and it is matchable in a single reading.

Look at what each line did. The board and level fixed the subject to one of four Mathematics courses. The exam session fixed the calendar. The school locality fixed the travel radius and the mock dates. The returned Paper 1 told the tutor what to open the first session with. The building detail decided whether a tutor can plan a standing slot at all. The two windows made the slot findable instead of negotiable. The home or online line set the mode and the fallback. The failed group class ruled out a format and said something true about the student. Not one of those lines was about us, and every one of them was about the match.

You do not need to write it as neatly as that. Bullet points are fine. Send it through the form on this site, or through the contact page it sits on, in whatever order it comes out, and leave the gaps as gaps rather than guessing. A guess is much harder to correct later than a blank.
bullets: Weak: 'need maths tutor Bandra'. No board, level, year or slot.
Strong: board, level, session, school locality, problem, access, windows, mode.

sections.heading: What a good enquiry can and cannot change
paragraphs: A detailed enquiry changes the speed and the accuracy of the match. It does not change the work. Four weeks in, the honest marker of progress is that homework is being started without a fight and the tutor can name the next three things to fix.

At four weeks, expect diagnosis rather than transformation. The tutor should be able to tell you precisely where the marks are going: a Chemistry student losing them on significant figures and units rather than on concepts, a History student writing narrative where the criterion asks for evaluation. At one term, expect a visible change in one measurable thing, usually a paper type or a single criterion, and no change at all in the areas you did not book the tutor to fix. At one full exam cycle you can judge the arrangement properly, because mocks, an IA cycle and a real paper have all happened by then.

It can also go wrong, and the enquiry affects how fast that gets fixed. If three sessions in the fit is clearly off, say so plainly and name what is off: pace, explanation style, the tutor arriving late, a mismatch on the level. The match is then redone from the original enquiry plus that note, which takes days rather than weeks precisely because the enquiry was detailed the first time. Asking for a replacement is not a complaint and nobody here treats it as one.

What stays true regardless: IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no tutor should promise a number either. IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the board, the level, the scarcity of the subject, how far the tutor travels and how long the session runs, which is why this page quotes none of them, and why a tutor who quotes a grade and a price in the same sentence is worth less than one who quotes neither.
bullets: Four weeks: expect accurate diagnosis, not a transformed report card.
One term: one paper type or criterion visibly improved.
One exam cycle: enough evidence to judge the arrangement properly.
Not working? Say what is off and the match is redone.
