sections.heading: Writing your IB Gram contact in Mumbai enquiry today
paragraphs: Open the enquiry form on this site and write five things: board and programme, subject and level, school and year group, locality with building access, and two time windows. Add the specific problem if you have one, and the mode you prefer. That is the whole enquiry.

Before the first session, put three things on the table: the most recent returned paper or marked task, the syllabus or subject guide if the school has issued one, and the school's calendar for the next six weeks. The tutor will ask for all three anyway, and having them ready turns session one into teaching instead of an audit. Decide where the sessions will happen before the tutor arrives, because a dining table with the television off is a better study space than a bedroom desk nobody uses, and a tutor cannot fix a room from outside it.

The first session itself is diagnostic and should feel like it. Expect the tutor to read one piece of the child's own work, ask the child to attempt something while they watch, and finish by naming what they will work on and in what order. Ask for that order out loud before they leave. If you get a vague answer at the end of the first session you have learned something useful early, and an IB private tutor in Mumbai who cannot name a first target is not the right one for a full term.

One honest note on timing: we do not publish a response time and we will not invent one. An IB tutor in Mumbai for a common subject in the Western Suburbs is found faster than a scarce Higher Level subject in Panvel, and telling you otherwise would waste your week. Write the enquiry once, properly, and the rest of it moves at the speed the subject allows.

faqs.question: What exactly should I write in my first enquiry to IB Gram?
faqs.answer: Write seven things: the board and programme, the exact subject and level, the year group and exam session, the school, your locality with building access, two time windows that genuinely work, and whether you want home tuition or online. An IB Gram contact in Mumbai that arrives with those seven lines can be matched in one reading. Add the specific problem if there is one, a returned paper, a criterion, a mock result, because that tells the tutor what to open the first session with. Anything you do not know, leave blank rather than guess at it.

faqs.question: Is there a phone number I can call instead of filling in the form?
faqs.answer: The enquiry form on this site, and the contact page it sits on, are the routes we can act on, so start there. The reason is not bureaucracy: a written enquiry keeps the board, level, locality and time window in one place where the person matching you can read them again, and a phone conversation loses exactly those details. The enquiry form is the IB Gram contact in Mumbai that we can work from, and once a conversation is open you can carry on in whichever way suits you. Write the details once and you will not be asked for them twice.

faqs.question: How long will it take to hear back after I send an enquiry?
faqs.answer: We do not publish a response time and we will not invent one. A common subject in a well-covered locality is matched faster than a scarce Higher Level subject at the edge of the city, and quoting an average would be a sales line rather than information. What is in your control is the detail in the enquiry: a message that already answers the obvious questions skips the whole round of questions. If your deadline is close, say so in the enquiry and say what the deadline actually is, because that changes the order in which things get looked at.

faqs.question: My enquiry said 'need maths tutor Bandra'. What was missing from it?
faqs.answer: Everything that decides the match. Maths in Bandra could mean IGCSE Core, IGCSE Extended, MYP Mathematics, DP Applications and Interpretation SL or DP Analysis and Approaches HL, and those are five different tutors. Bandra could mean Bandra West near Linking Road or Bandra East near the Western Express Highway, which are two different travel problems. There was no year group, no exam session, no school, no time window and no statement of what is actually going wrong. Add those and the same enquiry becomes matchable; leave them out and the first reply you get is a questionnaire.

faqs.question: Will a home tutor really come to Kandivali East on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the slot is realistic and fixed. Kandivali East sits off the Western Express Highway on the Western Line, and a tutor living along that stretch, Malad, Borivali, Kandivali West, can hold a standing weekday evening slot for a full term. A tutor commuting from South Mumbai for the same slot cannot, whatever they say in week one. This is why the enquiry should name the locality and two windows: we match along your corridor rather than across the city. If your only possible slot is seven in the evening on a weekday, say that first, not last.

faqs.question: Does our society's gate and visitor process matter to the enquiry?
faqs.answer: It matters more than most parents expect, so mention it. A tutor who needs a fresh visitor pass at the gate every week, or who is turned back because the app approval did not come through, loses ten minutes a session and eventually loses the slot. If your society issues a standing pass for regular visitors, say so, and start that paperwork before the first session. Tell us the tower and floor, whether the lift is working, and whether a parent or helper will be home to open the door. These details turn a good match into a session that actually happens.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on?
faqs.answer: They depend on the board, the level, how scarce the subject is, how far the tutor travels and how long the session runs. A Diploma Programme Higher Level science with an IA attached sits differently from an IGCSE Core subject, and a tutor crossing Ghodbunder Road in the evening is pricing travel as well as teaching. This page quotes no figures because any number written here would be wrong for most families reading it. Ask for the rate in writing before the first session, ask what a cancelled session costs, and ask whether the rate changes near exams.

faqs.question: We have already tried two tutors. Should I say that in the enquiry?
faqs.answer: Say it, and say what did not work. 'Explained well but never checked homework', 'kept re-teaching content she already knew', 'always late', and 'good for IGCSE but lost in the IA' are four completely different problems that point to four different replacements. Without that line we are matching blind and may send you the same kind of profile again. Nobody reads it as criticism of your child or of you. Some of the most useful enquiries we get are second-attempt ones, because the parent already knows what the wrong fit looks like and can describe it precisely.

faqs.question: Can I ask for a tutor from my child's own school?
faqs.answer: You can describe the experience you want, but not request a school's staff through us. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school, so we do not present tutors as anyone's teacher or recruit from a named staff room. What you can reasonably ask for is a tutor who has taught your board and level, who knows the assessment calendar that kind of school runs on, and who has taken students through the same transfer or the same paper. Ask for the experience by description and the shortlist will be better than asking by institution.

faqs.question: What happens if nobody suitable exists for my subject and time slot?
faqs.answer: We tell you, rather than sending you a near-miss. Some combinations are genuinely thin: a rare second language at Higher Level, a specialist option inside a science, a weekday morning slot, an address a long way from any tutor's base. When that happens the honest options are an online tutor instead of a home tutor, a different time window, or waiting. We will say which of those we think is most likely to work and why. A tutor who is wrong on level or wrong on distance will not last a term, so matching you to one is not a favour.

faqs.question: Does sending an enquiry commit me to anything?
faqs.answer: No. An IB Gram contact in Mumbai commits you to nothing: there is no fee at the enquiry stage, no obligation to book anyone on the shortlist, and no automatic follow-up schedule you have to escape from. You can read the shortlist, meet one tutor, meet none of them, or come back in three months when the term calms down. Your details are used to find the match and are not published anywhere on this site. If you decide the timing is wrong, say so and the enquiry is closed rather than kept warm.

faqs.question: Should I send one enquiry for two children or two separate ones?
faqs.answer: Send one enquiry and describe both children clearly, because the logistics are shared and the teaching is not. A Year 9 IGCSE student and a DP1 sibling in the same Powai flat may be matched to two tutors, or occasionally to one tutor across back-to-back slots if the subjects and levels align. Either way we need both year groups, both boards and both subject lists, plus whether you want the sessions consecutive or on different days. Consecutive slots are easier on the tutor's travel and often easier to hold through exam season.

sections.heading: How a request for IB Gram fees in Mumbai turns into a shortlist
paragraphs: A rate exists only once a request exists. Tell us the board, the subject, the year, the area and the two evenings you can hold, and a coordinator reads it the same way a tutor will: can I get there by seven, do I know this syllabus at this level, can I commit to that slot until the examination series. Only tutors who answer yes to all three are contacted, and each one quotes their own rate for that pattern rather than reading a figure off a tariff card.

That is why IB Gram fees in Mumbai are quoted per match and never printed as an hourly number on a public page. The same subject, the same year and the same school can produce two very different quotes because one tutor lives in the next lane and the other crosses the Western Express Highway at seven in the evening. Parents who type searches like IB tutors near me in Mumbai are already halfway to the answer: proximity is a price factor here, not a convenience.

Expect an IB home tutor in Mumbai to ask questions before quoting, and treat that as a good sign. A Diploma Programme (DP) Physics Higher Level (HL) teacher will want to know whether the Internal Assessment (IA) draft is written, because supervising a half-finished investigation in February is different work from teaching mechanics in July. A Middle Years Programme (MYP) parent will be asked which criteria the last report flagged. The quote follows the work, so vague requests produce vague figures and precise requests produce a rate you can hold a tutor to.

Nothing is charged for the matching itself, and the shortlist arrives with the rate already attached to each name so you are comparing like with like: same subject, same session length, same travel. Where two quotes differ, the difference is explainable, and you should ask what explains it. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any school named on this page, and we do not guarantee grades. What the process can do is make the cost of a term predictable before you commit an evening to it.

sections.heading: Why does a DP Higher Level tutor in Mumbai cost more than an MYP one?
paragraphs: Because the pool is smaller. The number of teachers in Mumbai who have taught, marked or examined International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP) subjects at Higher Level (HL) is a fraction of the number who can teach Middle Years Programme (MYP) classes well, and a scarce skill is priced like one. Level, not effort, is the first fee factor any parent should reason about.

Walk up the ladder and you can place yourself on it. Primary Years Programme (PYP) support draws the broadest pool, because a strong primary teacher with inquiry experience covers it. MYP work needs someone fluent in the criteria and the command terms, and in the eAssessment years that pool narrows again. Cambridge International Education IGCSE sits above it, with the Core and Extended split deciding how specialised the teaching has to be. DP Standard Level (SL) is a genuine specialism, and DP HL is a smaller specialism still.

The Core and Extended decision carries a fee consequence parents rarely expect. A student moved from Core to Extended Mathematics in Year 10 needs someone who can teach the extra content and the harder paper technique at speed, and that is closer to DP-level work than to ordinary IGCSE revision. The same applies to a student taking a subject at HL after a weak SL prediction: the gap is in technique rather than content, and technique teaching is the expensive kind because very few teachers can do it in a term.

Then there is the supervision layer, which sits on top of teaching and is priced separately in a tutor's head. The Extended Essay (EE), the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay and each subject's Internal Assessment (IA) are marked against criteria most parents have never read, and a tutor who has sat on a moderation panel reads a draft in minutes rather than hours. Pearson Edexcel and Cambridge coursework behave the same way. One enquiry covers all IB and IGCSE subjects spanning IB and IGCSE, Years 1-12 home tuition in Mumbai, from a PYP reading gap to a DP2 retake, but the rate inside it moves with the level.

sections.heading: Subject scarcity: what a Maths AA HL home tutor in Mumbai actually prices
paragraphs: Subject scarcity is the second fee factor and it bites harder than the level factor. Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches (AA) at Higher Level, Physics HL and the Language B subjects sit at the thin end of the Mumbai supply curve, because each needs a teacher who is both qualified in the subject and current with the IB's own assessment style.

Maths AA HL is the clearest case. The syllabus carries proof, calculus and a Paper 3 that asks an unfamiliar extended question, so a tutor has to be comfortable being watched while solving something they have not seen before. Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (AI) at Standard Level draws a far wider pool, which is why a family switching a child from AA HL to AI SL often sees the quote move as much as the timetable does. Physics HL behaves identically, with the option topic and the treatment of uncertainties separating the teachers who can from the teachers who believe they can.

Languages are the quiet scarcity nobody plans for. French B, Spanish B, German B and Hindi B at Higher Level need a near-native speaker who can also teach the individual oral and the written assignment against the criteria, and in Mumbai that combination is rare enough that online matching is often the honest answer rather than a compromise. Language A: Literature is easier to staff and harder to teach well, because the comparative essay rewards a reader rather than a summariser, and a tutor who only knows the set texts runs out of material by the second month.

On the Cambridge side the syllabus codes tell you where the pool thins. IGCSE Mathematics (0580) and English as a First Language (0500) are widely taught across the city; Additional Mathematics (0606), Physics (0625) at the harder end and Economics (0455) with its data-response paper are narrower. A request for all IB and IGCSE subjects home tuition in Mumbai is answered subject by subject rather than as a bundle, because the person who can repair Chemistry (0620) paper technique is rarely the person who can rescue a Business Management IA three weeks before submission.

sections.heading: What does home tuition cost across Mumbai's six zones?
paragraphs: It depends on the evening, not the distance. A tutor prices the block of time your session consumes, and in Mumbai, Maharashtra that block includes the road. IB Gram fees in Mumbai follow the evening rather than the kilometre, which is why a Kasarvadavali booking and a Dadar booking of identical length are quoted differently by the same tutor.

South Mumbai is short-distance and slow. A tutor moving from Worli to Colaba, Cuffe Parade or Peddar Road covers very little ground and can still lose most of an hour to the Haji Ali and Peddar Road signals, so tutors here are matched inside the island rather than brought down the Western Line. The Coastal Road and Metro Line 3 have eased the Walkeshwar and Cuffe Parade runs. In the Western Suburbs the rule is to match along the line: Bandra West to Khar West to Santacruz West holds for a year, Juhu to Goregaon East at seven in the evening does not, even with the Western Express Highway, Link Road, Metro Line 2A and Metro Line 7 all pointing the same way.

The Central Suburbs hang off the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali reached by road from Andheri East, Ghatkopar or Kanjurmarg because Powai has no station of its own; the JVLR and the Santacruz–Chembur Link Road (SCLR) decide whether that trip takes twenty minutes or fifty. Mulund tutors cover Mulund and sometimes cross into Thane. In the Eastern Suburbs, Chembur, Govandi, Wadala, Vikhroli and Bhandup are served by the Harbour and Central lines, and the Eastern Freeway makes a Chembur tutor a realistic weekday option for a Wadala family in a way the map hides completely.

Navi Mumbai works node to node. Vashi, Nerul, Seawoods, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel each sit a short run from the next along Palm Beach Road and the Sion–Panvel Highway, with the Navi Mumbai Metro and the Trans-Harbour Line carrying the rest; the Atal Setu has made a Panvel-to-island-city trip possible without making it sensible for a weekly evening home class. Thane spreads from the station out along Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali and Hiranandani Estate, and the Ghodbunder stretch alone can double a tutor's travel time after six. Booking a tutor who must cross the Bandra–Worli Sea Link twice a week is the arrangement most likely to collapse by October.

sections.heading: The Mumbai school calendar decides when tutoring gets expensive
paragraphs: Demand, not policy, makes some months dearer than others. The Mumbai international school year opens in June, and families at Dhirubhai Ambani International School in Bandra Kurla Complex, the American School of Bombay, Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu and Oberoi International School on JVLR all reach the same assessment weeks together, so the good evening slots are gone by late September.

The pressure points are predictable enough to plan around. October and November carry the first MYP and DP internal deadlines plus the Cambridge October series, and the Diwali break interrupts exactly the fortnight most families had earmarked for catch-up. January and February are mock-examination months and the heaviest IA fortnight of the DP2 year, when a Chembur student can have a Physics IA draft and a TOK essay due in the same week. March to May is the examination run itself, when nobody is taking on new subjects.

School-level calendars matter more than the board calendar. Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Bombay International School at Babulnath, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade and Activity High School on Peddar Road set their own internal deadlines; Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, NES International School in Mulund West, Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul sit in different traffic zones as well as different calendars. A request in August is easier to fill than the identical request in January, because in August you are choosing from tutors and in January tutors are choosing from you.

Naming a school here is local context and nothing more. IB Gram is an independent platform with no affiliation to any school, board or examination body mentioned, and we do not guarantee grades or predicted-grade changes. What the calendar does tell you is when to ask. Book a standing slot in June or July and you are negotiating a rate. Ask in February for a DP2 Maths AA HL slot and you are negotiating availability, which is the more expensive thing to be short of in this city.
bullets: June to September is when standing evening slots are still available
October and November collide with the Diwali break and the Cambridge series
January and February are mock months and the heaviest IA fortnight
A February request buys availability rather than a better rate
School calendars differ even between two IB schools in one zone

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid: what each one does to the fee
paragraphs: Home tutoring is the lead service and the most expensive to deliver, because the tutor is selling an evening rather than an hour. A ninety-minute home class in Kandivali East can occupy three hours of a tutor's day door to door, and any honest quote reflects that. Travel load is the single most underrated part of what a Mumbai family actually pays for.

Online removes the travel and leaves the scarcity. Book an IB online tutor in Mumbai and the Maths AA HL specialist sitting in Thane becomes available to a family in Cuffe Parade, and the part of IB Gram fees in Mumbai that pays for travel disappears from the quote entirely. What does not disappear is the supervision cost: a DP2 Economics IA takes the same reading hours wherever the tutor is sitting. Online also fails quietly for younger students, so PYP and early MYP work usually belongs at the dining table with an adult in the room.

Hybrid is where most families end up, and it is worth asking for by name instead of discovering it in March. One home class a week to hold the routine, plus a short online clinic before a test, costs less than two home visits and keeps the travel load at a single evening. In the weeks before the May session, families on Ghodbunder Road and in Panvel often flip the ratio completely: online on weekday evenings, one long session at the weekend when the roads are survivable and the student has the energy for two papers.

The honest trade-offs are these. Home tuition gives you attention, a tutor who sees the study space and a child who cannot quietly close a tab, but it loses time to traffic and the session can start late through nobody's fault. Online is punctual, recordable and cheaper on travel, and it demands a wired desk, a charged device and a parent who looks in twice. A tutor who cheerfully agrees to cross the city every weekday evening is usually the tutor who cancels in August.
bullets: Home tuition prices an evening, not an hour: travel is folded in
Online drops the travel load and leaves the subject scarcity premium
Hybrid holds one home class a week plus a short online clinic
PYP and early MYP learners do poorly in long online sessions
A weekday cross-city visit is the arrangement most likely to lapse

sections.heading: How does IB Gram check a tutor in Mumbai before you pay anything?
paragraphs: Identity, qualification and board experience are checked before a name reaches you. IB Gram verifies a government photo identity document, the degree a tutor claims and the IB or Cambridge teaching history they describe, then interviews them on the specific subject and level they want to be matched for. Profiles that fail any of those steps are not sent to families.

The subject interview is the part that matters for fees. A tutor asking to be listed for Physics HL is asked to talk through an uncertainty calculation and an unseen past-paper question; one asking for MYP English is asked how they would mark against Criterion C and what feedback they would write underneath. This is why a verified tutor quotes more confidently: they have already demonstrated the level they are charging for, and they know a parent can test it in the first session.

Then do your own checks, because those are the ones that protect your money. Ask which syllabus version the tutor last taught and which examination series they prepared students for. Ask them to mark one of your child's past-paper answers in front of you and explain the mark scheme line by line. Ask what the first three sessions would contain. An IB private tutor in Mumbai who cannot answer those three questions in plain language is not cheap at any rate, because you will be paying for the weeks it takes to find out.

Verification has limits worth stating plainly. A checked profile is evidence of competence, not of chemistry with your child, and we do not guarantee grades or examination outcomes. Nothing in a document predicts whether a fifteen-year-old will work for this particular adult on a Tuesday evening. That is what the first session is for, and it is why re-matching exists at no extra matching cost: a tutor who is right on paper and wrong in the room should be changed in week two, not endured until the mocks.
bullets: Photo identity, degree and claimed board experience checked before any shortlist
Subject interview at the exact level the tutor wants to teach
Ask the tutor to mark a past-paper answer in front of you
Ask which syllabus version and examination series they last taught
Re-matching carries no additional matching charge at any point

sections.heading: What do IB Gram fees in Mumbai actually depend on?
paragraphs: Seven things, in roughly this order of weight. IB Gram fees in Mumbai rest on the board and programme, the scarcity of the subject, how close the examination is, the session length and frequency, the travel load the tutor absorbs, whether teaching happens at home or online, and whether one child or two are in the room.

Board and programme set the floor, because they decide which pool you are hiring from. Subject scarcity then moves the quote inside that pool, which is why two DP HL requests from the same building can be priced differently. Exam proximity acts like a surcharge nobody announces: by January a good tutor is turning work away, and a parent asking about IB tuition fees in Mumbai eleven weeks before Paper 1 is asking for the scarcest commodity in this market, which is a free Tuesday evening in February.

Session design is the factor families control, and the one most often got wrong. Two ninety-minute sessions a week cost more than one but usually work better than a single two-and-a-half-hour marathon, because attention rather than time is the binding limit. A pair of siblings taking the same subject at the same level shares one evening and one journey, and tutors price that as one job with an uplift rather than as two bookings; siblings in different years or different programmes are two jobs and should be quoted as two. Travel holds the biggest surprises, and it works in blocks: a tutor who accepts a six o'clock slot in Powai or Kasarvadavali is giving up that entire evening, not forty minutes of it.

A published number would be a guess dressed as information. Until the subject, the level, the slot and the address exist, the variables that set a rate do not, and a figure quoted without them would be wrong in both directions at once: high enough to frighten a family who needed one term of MYP Maths support, low enough to mislead a DP2 family who needs a Physics HL examiner on a Saturday morning in Kharghar. So the rate comes from the tutor, after the request, in writing, and the useful service is explaining the factors clearly enough that you can predict your own range before anyone quotes you.
bullets: Board and programme set which tutor pool you are hiring from
Scarce subjects move the quote upward inside that pool
Exam proximity behaves like an unannounced surcharge on availability
Two shorter sessions usually beat one long one for the same money
A sibling pair in one subject shares the evening and the journey
Travel is charged as an evening block, not as kilometres covered

sections.heading: Why does the cheapest quote in Mumbai often cost more over a term?
paragraphs: Because the cheapest quote usually comes from the least committed evening. A tutor who underprices a cross-city slot is a tutor who will renegotiate it, cancel it through the monsoon or drop it the moment a nearer booking appears, and a term broken in three places costs far more than the difference in the rate ever saved.

Count the real cost of churn before you choose on price. Losing a tutor in week five means two weeks of silence, a fortnight of re-matching and a new adult who spends three sessions discovering the gaps the last one had already found. In a DP2 year that is the IA window gone. The best IB tutor in Mumbai for your child is usually neither the lowest quote nor the highest: it is the one whose travel and timetable make your slot easy to keep from June to May.

Progress has a shape, and knowing it stops you paying for panic later. At four weeks you should see a diagnosis you recognise, command terms being used correctly and one paper-technique habit fixed, not a grade jump. At one term, expect steadier class tests, IA drafts arriving before the school deadline and a predicted grade that has stopped sliding. Across a full examination cycle the gains come from past-paper discipline and mark-scheme literacy. We do not guarantee grades, and a tutor who does is telling you something about their honesty rather than their teaching.

Signals that a rate is honest: it arrives with a session length, a stated travel assumption and a cancellation rule. Signals to question: a quote that drops sharply the moment you hesitate, a whole term demanded upfront before any teaching has happened, or a promise about a final grade. Paying monthly for sessions already delivered, against a short written agreement, keeps the incentive where it belongs and makes a change of tutor a one-week problem instead of a refund negotiation in the middle of mock season.
bullets: An honest quote names session length, travel assumption and cancellation terms
Four weeks buys diagnosis and technique, not a grade jump
One term should show IA drafts landing before school deadlines
Question any quote that falls sharply the moment you hesitate
Pay after sessions delivered so changing tutors stays a small problem

sections.heading: What to agree before session one, and what a first home class covers
paragraphs: Arrive at the first conversation with five things and the quote becomes concrete: the last report card, the subject outline or IA brief, the two evenings you can genuinely hold every week, the address with its gate and parking reality, and the one problem you most want fixed. A home tutor who has all five can price the work instead of guessing at it.

Agree six points before the first session, in a message if nothing else: the rate and the session length it covers; how many sessions a week; when payment happens, which is usually per session or at the end of each month; how much notice a cancellation needs and who absorbs a late one; what happens across school holidays and the Diwali break; and what happens if you change tutors mid-term. Families who settle those six spend the year arguing about Physics instead of arguing about money.

The first home class is diagnostic and should look like it. Expect past-paper questions rather than a lecture, questions about how the student revises and what they do when stuck, a look at the last two assessments, and a short plan for the next month with something the student completes before session two. A tutor who teaches for ninety minutes without finding out what is broken is a tutor you will be re-matching in October.

Then hold the slot, because that is the part only you control. The families who get the most from home tuition in Mumbai protect one evening a week from everything else, keep a desk clear of other people's laptops, and tell the tutor about a test ten days out rather than the night before. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai can be found in most zones; a family who keeps the slot is what makes the match last until the examination series.
bullets: Bring the last report card and the subject outline or IA brief
Agree rate, session length, frequency and payment timing in writing
Settle the missed-session policy before a session is ever missed
Expect a diagnostic first session, not a ninety-minute lecture
Protect one evening a week and flag tests ten days early

faqs.question: Why does IB Gram not publish a fee list for Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Because IB Gram fees in Mumbai are quoted by the tutor after the request exists, and before that the variables that set a rate do not. The board, the programme, the level, how scarce the subject is, the session length, the frequency and the evening a tutor gives up to reach your building all move the figure, and none of them is known until you have named the subject, the year, the area and the slot. One published number would mislead an MYP family in one direction and a DP2 Physics Higher Level family in the other. You get a written rate with the shortlist, before anything is booked.

faqs.question: What makes one tutor's rate higher than another's for the same subject?
faqs.answer: Scarcity, examiner-level experience and travel, in that order. Two tutors listed for Diploma Programme Chemistry can be priced differently because one has marked the Internal Assessment against the criteria while the other has only taught the content, and because one lives in Chembur while the other crosses the Eastern Express Highway in the evening peak. Session length and frequency shift the per-session figure as well. Ask each shortlisted tutor to state the rate, the session length it covers and the travel assumption behind it, and the gap between two quotes usually explains itself in a sentence.

faqs.question: Does a tutor charge extra for travelling to our building in the evening?
faqs.answer: Usually it is built into the quote rather than added as a separate line. A tutor prices the whole block your session consumes, so a six o'clock slot in Powai or off Ghodbunder Road that eats an evening is quoted above a nine-minute walk in Khar West. What helps is making the travel predictable: give the exact building and wing, the gate the tutor should use, whether a visitor pass takes ten minutes to issue and whether parking exists at all. A tutor who is not surprised on arrival will not ask to renegotiate in week three.

faqs.question: We live off Ghodbunder Road in Thane. Does a tutor's travel change what we pay?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the honest fix is matching locally rather than paying for a longer drive. The Ghodbunder Road stretch out to Kasarvadavali and Hiranandani Estate can take three times as long after six as it does at noon, so a tutor living near Thane station prices a Kasarvadavali evening above a Majiwada one. Families there generally do better with a Thane-based tutor for weekly home classes, keeping an online specialist for a scarce subject such as Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at Higher Level. A tutor brought from Mulund twice a week rarely survives a full term.

faqs.question: Can two siblings share a session, and what does that do to the fee?
faqs.answer: Yes, if they are in the same subject at the same level, and it is the one genuine saving available. Two siblings sitting IGCSE Physics together share the evening, the journey and the explanation, and tutors price that as one job with a modest uplift rather than as two bookings. Two children in different programmes, or the same subject two years apart, is two jobs: the tutor teaches twice and should be paid twice, and compressing both into one session short-changes the younger one. Ask for the pair rate explicitly so it is written down from the start.

faqs.question: What should we agree with a tutor before the first home class?
faqs.answer: Six things: the rate and the session length it covers, the number of sessions a week, when payment happens, how much notice a cancellation needs and who absorbs a late one, what happens in school holidays and the Diwali break, and what happens if you change tutors mid-term. Put it in a message so both sides hold the same version. Most disputes families describe are not about the amount at all; they are about a missed session nobody had agreed a rule for, or a holiday month billed as a full one.

faqs.question: Is online cheaper than home tuition for DP Maths in Powai?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, because the travel load comes out of the quote. Powai has no railway station of its own, so a tutor arrives by road from Andheri East, Ghatkopar or Kanjurmarg along the JVLR, and that evening is what you pay for alongside the teaching. Online removes it and widens the pool to a Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches Higher Level specialist anywhere in the city. The trade-off is real: a DP1 student who works better with an adult in the room gets less from a screen, so many Powai families settle on one home class a week with online clinics before tests.

faqs.question: What happens to the fee if we miss a session during exam week?
faqs.answer: Whatever you agreed in advance, which is exactly why agreeing it matters. The common arrangements are that a session cancelled with a day's notice is rescheduled at no cost, a same-day cancellation is charged because the tutor has already lost the evening, and a tutor cancellation is always rescheduled. Decide which applies before session one. In the January mock weeks, ask the tutor to hold a flexible second slot rather than cancelling the first, because a rescheduled session inside a crowded fortnight often turns into no session at all.

faqs.question: Do fees rise closer to the May examination session?
faqs.answer: Rates are not raised by IB Gram, but availability collapses, which has much the same effect on what a family ends up paying. By January a strong Higher Level tutor has a full week, and the slots still open are the awkward ones carrying a longer drive. Families who book a standing slot in June or July are negotiating a rate; families who ask in February are negotiating an evening. If you already know your child will need Physics or Mathematics support in Diploma Programme year two, the cheapest decision available is an early one.

faqs.question: If the tutor is not working out after three weeks, do we pay again to re-match?
faqs.answer: No. Re-matching carries no additional matching charge, and you owe only the sessions already taught. Tell us what is not working in specific terms: the pace, the fit with the syllabus, a tutor who explains well but never sets written work. That detail is what makes the second match better than the first, because the problem is usually a teaching-style mismatch rather than a competence one. Expect a replacement shortlist within a few days, and expect the new tutor to spend one session establishing where the student actually is.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home during a home tuition session in a Mumbai society?
faqs.answer: Not for the whole session, but someone should be in the flat, and most Mumbai societies require a resident to confirm a visitor anyway. Register the tutor at the gate as a standing weekly visitor so the pass is not renegotiated every Tuesday; many complexes in Powai, Kharghar and Thane issue a recurring entry once a resident confirms the slot. Hold the session at the dining table or in a study room rather than a bedroom, keep the television off, and look in twice. Tutors report the same slot working better where an adult is present.

You meet one, you agree the terms in writing, and the first home class is diagnostic. Nothing is charged for the match.

A trial is a diagnostic session, not a free lesson. This page explains what to send before it, what to watch while it runs, and the honest signals it is not a fit.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram turn a free trial class request in Mumbai into a shortlist?
paragraphs: An IB Gram free trial class in Mumbai begins as a request, not a lesson. You send the board, the year, the subject, the exact topic and what the last report or teacher comment said. IB Gram matches that against tutors who have actually taught that component, then proposes a trial session at a time that fits your week. The order matters more than parents expect. A tutor who has read the problem before arriving can diagnose inside the first twenty minutes instead of spending them asking questions you already answered on the form.

What you send decides what the trial is worth. The difference between a useful trial and a pleasant hour is almost entirely in the attachment. Send a photograph of a recent marked paper, with the examiner or teacher marks still on it, rather than the sentence she is weak in Maths. Send the syllabus or subject code, because 0580 IGCSE Mathematics Extended and Diploma Programme Mathematics Analysis and Approaches Higher Level are different jobs taught by different people. Send what the school said in its own words, including the phrase that worried you. Send the deadline that is actually scaring you: an Internal Assessment draft date, a mock week, a subject-change cutoff. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai does not exist as one person, so the detail is what points the request at the right specialist.

On the platform side, the shortlist is built from board and component experience first, then travel realism, then the slot. Travel realism is the one parents skip. A tutor who can reach you in forty minutes on a Saturday morning and ninety minutes on a Wednesday at seven is not a weekly fit, however good the trial goes, and it is better to know that before the trial than after four cancelled sessions in November. A match is a hypothesis, not a verdict. The trial exists to test it, and roughly one in a handful of hypotheses turns out wrong, which is the normal cost of matching rather than a failure of the process.
bullets: 1. Send the request: board, year, subject, the exact topic, and your locality or pin code.
2. Attach evidence: a recent marked paper, the teacher's comment, the syllabus or subject code.
3. Confirm the slot: day, time, home or online, and who will be in the flat.
4. Run the trial as a diagnostic: the tutor sets work, marks it, and names the gap.
5. Decide within two days, while you still remember what the tutor actually did.

sections.heading: Which programme and level the trial should be aimed at
paragraphs: Aim the trial at the decision in front of you, not at the subject in general. In the Primary Years Programme (PYP) that decision is usually reading fluency or number confidence, and a trial is mostly about whether the child will work with a stranger at all. In the Middle Years Programme (MYP) the decision is criterion-shaped: a Year 9 or Year 10 student losing marks on Criterion C in Sciences has an investigation-writing problem, not a knowledge problem, and the trial should be spent on a criterion strand rather than a chapter. In the Diploma Programme (DP) the decision is usually Higher Level (HL) versus Standard Level (SL), an Internal Assessment (IA) that has stalled, or a predicted grade that came back lower than expected.

On the Cambridge International Education side, the live decision at IGCSE is almost always the tier. Core and Extended are different papers with different ceilings, and a student sitting the wrong one either loses the top grades she could have reached or spends two years drowning. A trial aimed at that question looks different from a trial aimed at revision: the tutor should put an Extended paper question in front of her, watch her attempt it, and tell you what the gap between her and that tier actually is. Pearson Edexcel International GCSE runs its own papers and its own practical arrangements, so name the board when you book. All IB and IGCSE subjects in home classes across Mumbai are taught to a specific syllabus edition, and a tutor who cannot name the edition is guessing.

Subject choice across both boards carries its own trial use. If a MYP 5 student is choosing DP subjects, a single session on a sample HL question in the subject she is considering tells you more than a term of advice. The same applies in reverse: a DP 1 student considering dropping from HL to SL should spend a trial on an HL Paper question and an SL Paper question back to back, so the decision rests on evidence rather than on how tired she felt in March. There is no best IB tutor in Mumbai in the abstract. There is a tutor who fits this student, this component and this slot, and the trial is how you find out which.
bullets: PYP trial: will the child work with a stranger, and for how long before attention goes
MYP trial: one criterion strand with the published wording, not a textbook chapter
DP trial: an HL or SL past-paper question, or a stalled IA section with its criteria
IGCSE trial: a Core versus Extended tier test on real paper questions
Subject-choice trial: a sample HL question in the subject she is considering next year

sections.heading: What a home tuition trial should cover, subject by subject
paragraphs: In Mathematics, the trial should open with a past-paper question, not a topic. For IGCSE Mathematics the useful test is a structured Paper 4 question with several parts, because it shows whether the student can carry a method through to the final mark or stops at the first awkward step. For DP Mathematics Analysis and Approaches, a Paper 1 question without a calculator and a Paper 2 question with one are two separate diagnoses, and a tutor who only looks at the calculator paper will miss the algebra that is actually failing. Ask the tutor to mark method marks separately from answer marks in front of you, because that is where most of the recoverable marks sit.

In the Sciences the trial should include one extended-response question and one practical-skills question. An IGCSE Physics or Chemistry candidate who writes fluent paragraphs can still lose most of a six-mark describe-an-experiment question for never naming a measuring instrument. A DP Biology student stuck on her IA usually has a problem with the independent variable or the controlled variables, not with biology, and twenty minutes on the IA criteria will show that faster than any revision. In languages, a DP English A Language and Literature trial should be a guided analysis on an unseen text with the tutor reading the assessment criteria out loud. In Economics, use a fifteen-mark evaluation question, because evaluation is the skill the marks hang on.

Every subject carries internal assessment of some kind, and a trial is a good moment to find out whether the tutor has marked it or only heard of it. DP subjects carry IAs, the Extended Essay (EE) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) sit across all of them, and Business Management, Psychology and the Sciences each have their own criteria and word limits. Ask which IA criteria the tutor has worked with directly. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects, a home tutor in Mumbai who can quote the criterion wording from memory has taught it; one who says we will look at the rubric later has not.
bullets: Maths: a multi-part past-paper question, with method marks marked separately in front of you
Sciences: one six-mark extended response plus one practical or data-analysis question
Languages: a guided analysis on an unseen text, criteria read out loud
Humanities: a fifteen-mark evaluation question, not a list of definitions
Any DP subject: twenty minutes on the live IA section and its criteria

sections.heading: Where trial sessions happen across Mumbai's six zones
paragraphs: An IB Gram free trial class in Mumbai can be arranged in any of the six zones of Mumbai, Maharashtra, and the zone changes what a sensible first slot looks like. South Mumbai is short-distance and slow: a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba or Cuffe Parade covers a few kilometres and can still lose most of an hour to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals, so a seven o'clock weekday trial in Walkeshwar or Babulnath is a poor test. The tutor arrives late and rushed and you learn nothing about the teaching. Book the island trial on a Saturday morning instead. Families near the Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort and B.D. Somani International School at Cuffe Parade are usually matched inside the island rather than brought down from the suburbs, with Metro Line 3 and the Coastal Road easing the Worli to Nariman Point run.

The Western Suburbs run north to south along the Western Line and the Western Express Highway, from Bandra and Khar West through Santacruz West, Juhu and Andheri up to Goregaon East, Malad, Kandivali East, Borivali and Dahisar East. Matching along the line works; matching across it does not. A Juhu tutor offered a Kandivali East slot at six in the evening is a scheduling bet, and the trial will not tell you whether the bet holds in July. Metro Lines 2A and 7 and Metro Line 1 from Versova through Andheri to Ghatkopar have made some of those crossings survivable, and Link Road is the usual alternative when the highway stalls. The Central Suburbs sit on the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali hanging off JVLR between them. Powai has no station of its own, so tutors reach it by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar, and a Hiranandani Foundation School family booking a trial should ask which of those three the tutor is starting from.

The Eastern Suburbs stretch from Chembur and Govandi through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund, served by the Central and Harbour lines, the Eastern Express Highway and the Eastern Freeway, which makes South Mumbai reachable from Chembur and Wadala faster than the map suggests. Navi Mumbai is planned in nodes, so trials are arranged node to node: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel are short drives apart on Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, while the Harbour and Trans-Harbour lines and the Atal Setu handle the longer crossings. A Nerul family near D.Y. Patil International School should be cautious about a tutor who lives on the island; the trial will go fine and the Wednesday slot will not survive the term. Thane spreads from the station across Pokhran Road and Majiwada out along Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali, and that stretch sets the schedule: twenty minutes off-peak, close to an hour in the evening. Thane tutors cover Thane, and Mulund tutors sometimes cross over.

Western Suburbs: Bandra, Khar West, Santacruz West, Juhu, Andheri, Malad, Borivali and Dahisar East

sections.heading: When in the Mumbai school year is a trial session worth booking?
paragraphs: The best weeks to book a trial are the quiet fortnight after a report card and the fortnight before a mock series, and the worst are the weeks inside an assessment block. A trial during mock week tells you only that the student is exhausted. A trial in the ten days after results, when you have a marked paper in your hand and the teacher's comment in writing, gives the tutor something real to diagnose. Mumbai IB and IGCSE schools run broadly the same shape of year, and the pressure points are predictable enough to plan around.

August and September are settling months, with new DP 1 and MYP cohorts finding out what the step up actually involves. October and November bring the first serious internal assessments and the start of DP IA work, and that is when most families here start searching. December and January are the heaviest stretch for DP 2: IA deadlines, the TOK essay and the EE final draft stack inside a few weeks, which is also when it becomes too late for a trial to change much. February and March are mock season, with predicted grades following. The DP May examination session and the IGCSE May and June series close the year, and results in July reshuffle everything. Schools like Dhirubhai Ambani International School in Bandra Kurla Complex, the American School of Bombay, Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu, Oberoi International School off JVLR, Bombay International School at Babulnath and Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane each set their own internal calendar, so ask your coordinator for the assessment dates before you book anything.

Naming those schools here is local context and nothing more. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school, board or examination body named on this page, and it does not speak for any of them. A tutor matched through IB Gram is not a member of your school's staff and should not be described to your child as one. The practical reason this matters at trial stage is that a tutor who claims an inside line on a school's marking is telling you something that cannot be true, and that is a reason to end the conversation rather than a reason to book.
bullets: Best trial windows: the fortnight after a report card, or two weeks before mocks
Worst trial windows: mock week, exam week, and the last fortnight before an IA deadline
October and November: first internal assessments, DP IA work begins, demand peaks
December and January: IA, TOK essay and EE drafts land together for DP 2
Ask your coordinator for the written assessment calendar before booking a weekly slot

sections.heading: Home tuition trial or online trial: which one tells you more?
paragraphs: A home tuition trial tells you more about the student; an online trial tells you more about the teaching. Booking an IB Gram free trial class in Mumbai at home lets you see things no video call shows: whether she works at the dining table or disappears into a bedroom, whether the television is audible, whether she goes quiet in her own house, and whether the slot survives real traffic on a real Tuesday. It also tests the logistics that break weekly arrangements. Decide before the session where it will happen, who will be in the flat, and how the tutor gets past the gate.

An online trial removes travel as a variable, which is useful precisely when travel is the thing you are unsure about. It is also the honest answer for scarce subjects: an IB online tutor in Mumbai is often the only realistic option for DP Music, Further Mathematics, Mandarin B or a less common language, because the handful of people in the city who teach those components cannot cross six zones on a weeknight. Online trials show you a specific skill clearly. Watch whether the tutor annotates the actual past paper on screen, writes while explaining rather than talking over a static slide, and sends you anything afterwards. The trade-off is real: attention is harder to hold, a younger child usually needs a parent nearby, and a weak internet connection in a monsoon week will cost you half the session.

Hybrid is what most Mumbai families settle into after a term, and the trial is a reasonable place to test it. A common shape is one home session a week for the work that needs someone in the room, plus a short online session before a deadline for paper marking and feedback. If you expect to end up there, run the trial in whichever mode you are least sure about. IB home tuition in Mumbai costs more in travel time than online does, and that time is paid for in one way or another, so a mode decision taken at trial stage is also a budget decision taken early.

sections.heading: How is a home tutor in Mumbai checked before the trial session?
paragraphs: Before a trial is scheduled, IB Gram checks who the tutor is and what they have taught: a government photo identity document, proof of the degree they claim, their teaching history, and which boards, levels and components they have actually handled. Tutors who say they teach both boards are asked which syllabus editions and which papers, because the answer separates people who have taught IGCSE Extended from people who have read about it. References are taken where a tutor has them. None of this is a substitute for the twenty minutes of checking you do yourself during the trial, which is the part most parents skip.

Your own checks are simple and fast. Ask which syllabus edition they teach to and for which examination series. Ask them to name the assessment criteria for the piece of work your child is struggling with, without looking it up. Ask what they would set as homework after today, and how long it should take. Ask what they will send you after each session: a message, a marked paper, a line in a notebook, anything written. An IB private tutor in Mumbai who answers those four questions precisely has taught the course. One who answers in generalities about building confidence and strong fundamentals may still be a good teacher, but you have no evidence of it from this session.

Fees belong in the same conversation, before the trial rather than after it. IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on the board and level, how scarce the subject is, how far the tutor travels and how long each session runs. A DP HL Physics specialist travelling from Ghatkopar to Cuffe Parade on a weeknight is a different arrangement from an IGCSE Mathematics tutor three buildings away, and neither is quoted on this page because quoting a number we have not verified for your case would be dishonest. Whether a particular trial session carries a charge is confirmed to you in writing before it is scheduled. Ask for the per-session figure, the session length, and the notice period for cancellation in the same message.

sections.heading: Using the one shot you get: a strong trial and a weak trial on the same paper
paragraphs: Take one component and look at the same forty minutes twice. This is a composite illustration, not a case study. The material is an IGCSE Physics Paper 4 question worth six marks, asking the student to describe an experiment to find the specific heat capacity of a metal block. She has already sat it in a school test and lost four of the six marks, and that marked script is sitting in her bag.

In the strong version, the tutor reads the marked script in the first three minutes, hands it back with the marks folded over, and asks her to attempt it again cold while he watches. She writes four steps in about ninety seconds and stops. He marks what she wrote out loud against the mark scheme wording rather than against his own sense of a good answer, and the diagnosis arrives quickly: the physics is intact, because she knows that energy transferred equals mass times specific heat capacity times temperature change. What she loses marks for is method writing. She writes heat the block without naming the instrument, and never says that the temperature must be measured and recorded before and after. He names it in one sentence: you are not short of physics, you are short of measurable quantities. Then he hands her a near-identical question using water instead of metal, and the second attempt scores most of the marks. The last ten minutes go on writing down, on paper you keep, the single rule she will apply to every describe-an-experiment question for the next fortnight.

In the weak version, on identical material, the tutor opens a notebook and re-derives the equation for twenty-five minutes. The explanation is clear, correct and pleasant. The student says okay several times and writes nothing. No marked paper is asked for, no mark scheme is opened, no question is attempted, and nothing is written down for later. At the end the tutor says she has a good grasp of the concepts and needs more practice, a conclusion that fits every student alive and commits to nothing. The session felt good. You learned nothing you did not know beforehand, and your daughter walks into Monday's class with exactly the same instructions she had on Friday. Both tutors were polite, both were qualified, and only one of them did the job the trial exists for.
bullets: Does the student talk for a third of the session, or only listen and nod?
Does the tutor ask for a marked paper, or start from a blank page?

sections.heading: What the trial can and cannot tell you about the next six months
paragraphs: At four weeks, a working arrangement looks like this: homework between sessions actually gets done, the student can start a question without being told how to begin, and you can name in one sentence what is being worked on. That is the whole four-week test. Marks often have not moved yet, and a tutor who promises movement at four weeks is selling something. At one term, expect a visible shift in one component rather than across a subject: the structured Paper 4 questions hold together, or the IA has a method section her teacher accepted. Across a full examination cycle, predicted grades can move and often do, but IB Gram does not guarantee grades and neither should any tutor you speak to. Teaching is one input among the school, the student's own work and the examination itself.

The hardest judgement is the pleasant trial that is not a fit, and it is worth naming the signals plainly. The student did not speak unprompted once. The tutor talked about their own results and years of experience more than about the paper in front of them. You asked what the problem was and got an answer about confidence. The tutor would not commit to a specific next step, or committed to a grade. Nothing was written down. The slot only works if every signal on the Western Express Highway is kind. Any one of those is a reason to try a second tutor before settling, and asking for a second trial is a normal request, not an insult.

A tutor who is not working out after three or four weeks is also normal, and the useful response is specific rather than apologetic. Write down what is not happening: sessions running short, homework never set, the IA untouched, the student dreading Thursday. Send that to IB Gram and ask for a replacement with that history attached, so the next tutor starts from the gap rather than from scratch. IB tutors near me in Mumbai is how most parents start searching, and proximity is one variable out of four. The other three, component experience, diagnostic habit and a slot that survives the monsoon, are what the trial is for. That is the whole case for treating an IB Gram free trial class in Mumbai as a diagnostic session rather than a free lesson.

sections.heading: Booking an IB Gram free trial class in Mumbai: what to send first
paragraphs: Spend ten minutes on the request and you change what the trial can do. Photograph the most recent marked paper, including the marks and the teacher's handwriting. Write the board, the year group, the subject, the level and the syllabus or subject code. Write the exact topic or criterion, not the subject name. Add one line on the deadline that worries you and one line on what the school said. Say which days and times genuinely work, in your own locality, and whether you want the session at home or online. That request produces a shortlist; a request saying needs help in Maths produces guesswork.

On the day, set the session up so it can be judged. Put the table where you can hear it without sitting in it, keep the marked paper and a blank sheet on the table, and make sure someone is at home who can let the tutor in without a ten-minute call from the gate. Tell your child what the session is for in plain terms: this is not a test of her, it is a test of the tutor, and she is allowed to say she does not understand. Then stay out of the first twenty minutes. If a parent answers for the student, the diagnosis is worthless.

At the end, ask five questions before the tutor leaves, and write the answers down. What exactly did you diagnose today, in one sentence, without the word concepts. Which component or criterion were we on, and which mark was lost. What will she do before the next session and how long should it take. What will look different in four weeks and how will I see it. Which syllabus edition and paper are you teaching to. A tutor who answers all five clearly has given you a real diagnostic. A tutor who answers none of them has given you a pleasant hour, and you are entitled to try somebody else.
bullets: Send first: marked paper photo, board, year, level, syllabus code, exact topic
Add the deadline that worries you and the school's comment in its own words

faqs.question: Is the first session really free, and what does a trial actually cost?
faqs.answer: Whether a given trial session carries a charge is confirmed to you in writing before it is booked, and this page does not set those terms for any tutor. What an IB Gram free trial class in Mumbai buys is consistent: a diagnostic, not a discounted lesson. Ongoing fees depend on the board and level, how scarce the subject is, how far the tutor travels and how long each session runs, which is why no figure appears here. Ask for the per-session amount, the session length and the cancellation notice in the same message, before the trial, so you are not negotiating after a session that went well.

faqs.question: What should I send the tutor before the trial session?
faqs.answer: Send four things: a photograph of a recent marked paper with the marks still visible, the syllabus or subject code, the exact topic or assessment criterion, and what the school said in its own words. Add the deadline that is actually worrying you, whether that is an Internal Assessment draft, a mock series or a subject-change cutoff. A tutor who receives those four things can spend the first twenty minutes diagnosing instead of interviewing you. A tutor who receives only the subject name will spend half the session catching up to what you already knew, and that half is the half you needed.

faqs.question: The trial felt pleasant and my daughter liked the tutor. Is that enough?
faqs.answer: No, and this is the most common way a trial gets wasted. Liking the tutor is necessary and not sufficient. Ask yourself three questions afterwards: did your daughter attempt something herself, was the gap named in one specific sentence, and is anything written down that still exists on Monday. If the answer to all three is no, you watched a well-delivered explanation, not a diagnosis. Plenty of warm, qualified tutors never diagnose anything, and plenty of blunt ones fix a component in a fortnight. Judge the method first and the rapport second.

faqs.question: What questions should I ask at the end of the trial?
faqs.answer: Ask five. What exactly did you diagnose today, in one sentence, without using the word concepts. Which component or criterion were we working on, and which specific mark was lost. What will she do before the next session, and how long should that take. What will look different in four weeks, and how will I see it. Which syllabus edition and examination series are you teaching to. Write the answers down the same evening, because by the weekend you will remember the tone of the session and not the content, and the answers are the only evidence you will have.

faqs.question: Can a tutor reach our building off Ghodbunder Road in Thane for a seven o'clock trial on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Often yes, and it is still the wrong slot for a first session. The Ghodbunder Road stretch from Thane station to Kasarvadavali runs about twenty minutes off-peak and close to an hour in the evening peak, so a seven o'clock weekday trial usually means a tutor arriving late and teaching in a hurry. Book the trial on a Saturday or Sunday morning, judge the teaching properly, then test the weekday slot once as a second session before you commit to it weekly. Thane tutors generally cover Thane, and a tutor coming from Mulund or further west is the arrangement most likely to collapse by August.

faqs.question: Does our society gate need anything before the tutor arrives for a home tuition trial?
faqs.answer: Yes, and sorting it out in advance protects the session. Most Mumbai societies log visitors by phone number and many need a resident to approve entry through an app, so send the tutor's name and number to your security desk the day before and keep your phone to hand at the slot time. Tell the tutor which gate, which tower and which floor, and whether two-wheelers park elsewhere. Ten minutes lost at a gate is ten minutes off a diagnostic you only get once. For a standing weekly slot, ask your committee how a recurring visitor pass works in your complex.

faqs.question: Should a parent sit in on the trial session?
faqs.answer: Stay within earshot and out of the room for the first twenty minutes. You want to hear whether your child speaks, whether she is asked to attempt something, and whether the tutor references actual criteria, and none of that happens honestly with a parent at the table. Younger children and online sessions are the exception: a PYP or early MYP student usually needs somebody nearby to settle the first ten minutes. Come in at the end for the five questions. If you find yourself answering on your child's behalf during the session, the diagnosis stops being about her.

faqs.question: We are in Navi Mumbai and the tutor we liked lives in Bandra. Will that hold for a term?
faqs.answer: Usually not for a weekday evening slot. Pulling a tutor across the creek from the island city into Vashi, Nerul, Belapur or Kharghar works for a single trial that everybody is motivated to attend, then fails somewhere around the third month. Navi Mumbai matching works node to node, using Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, with the Atal Setu and the Trans-Harbour Line handling the longer crossings. If the Bandra tutor is genuinely the right subject specialist, run the arrangement online during the week and keep any in-person session for a weekend.

faqs.question: What happens if the trial goes well but the tutor is not working out after three weeks?
faqs.answer: Ask for a replacement and attach the history. Write down what is specifically not happening: sessions finishing early, homework never set, the Internal Assessment untouched, the student going quiet. Send that to IB Gram rather than a general complaint, so the next tutor starts from the gap instead of from scratch and you do not repeat three weeks. This is a routine request. A trial is a hypothesis about a match, and a share of hypotheses turn out wrong, which is the cost of matching rather than a sign that you chose badly.

faqs.question: Is there any point doing a trial in the middle of the May examination session?
faqs.answer: Very little for a Diploma Programme 2 candidate already sitting papers, and a fair amount for the year below. During the May session a trial cannot change the outcome, and the student's time is better spent on past papers than on meeting someone new. For a DP 1 or MYP 5 student, the May and June weeks are quiet and ideal: teachers are occupied with examinations, the student has time, and a diagnostic now sets up a whole year. The other good window is the ten days after a report card, when you have a marked paper and a written comment in hand.

faqs.question: Can the trial be online if we eventually want home classes, or is that a wasted session?
faqs.answer: It is not wasted, but it tests a different thing, so choose deliberately. An online trial shows you the teaching: whether the tutor annotates the real past paper, writes while explaining, and sends you something afterwards. A home session shows you the student: the study space, the distractions, and whether she goes quiet in her own house. Run the trial in the mode you are least sure about. If you have already decided on home tuition and only doubt the tutor's subject depth, an online trial answers that faster and without putting a bad traffic day between you and a fair judgement.

sections.heading: How IB Gram home tuition in Altamount Road is actually arranged
paragraphs: The whole arrangement rests on the brief you send, so it is worth doing properly. A good brief is four lines: the child's year and programme, the subject and level, the school, and what is going wrong in your words rather than the school's. The last line is the one that does the work. Struggling in Mathematics produces a generalist. Can execute a method but freezes on an unfamiliar question produces a specialist who knows exactly which habit to rebuild.

From there the sequence is fixed. 1. We read the brief and come back with a question or two, usually about level and about which evenings are genuinely free. 2. We shortlist two or three verified tutors who have taught that subject at that level recently and who already work inside the island city. 3. You get those profiles with a reason attached to each and an honest note on which suits which kind of student. 4. You take a free discovery call with whoever you prefer. 5. Lessons start only after you say yes, with building entry arranged before the first visit.

Two or three profiles is a deliberate choice and sometimes an unpopular one. Parents occasionally ask for a longer list, and a longer list moves the work back to them without improving the outcome. The useful thing a platform can add is judgement: a note saying this tutor is stronger on examination technique and this one is better with a student who has lost confidence. Fifteen profiles with star ratings is a directory, not a recommendation.

Where it is slower than you want: a scarce Higher Level (HL) combination in a thinly taught subject can take several days to shortlist properly, and we would rather take those days than send a near-miss. An IB Gram home tutor in Altamount Road is only useful if the subject and level actually match, and the cost of fixing a wrong match in October is a term.

sections.heading: Which boards and levels does IB Gram cover here?
paragraphs: The International Baccalaureate (IB) across all three programmes and Cambridge International Education at IGCSE, with Pearson Edexcel where a school follows it. In practice that means the Primary Years Programme (PYP) through to the Diploma Programme (DP), and Years 9 to 11 on the Cambridge route. Families on this stretch frequently need both at once, because an older child may be sitting Diploma Programme examinations while a younger one is choosing IGCSE tiers, and the two requests get matched separately rather than bundled onto one tutor.

Level is the part we press hardest on before sending anyone. Higher Level and Standard Level (SL) are not the same subject with different amounts of content, and a tutor who has only taught to Standard Level will teach a Higher Level student competently and still leave them short on the extended reasoning the harder papers ask for. On the Cambridge side, the Core and Extended tier decision shapes what a tutor should even be teaching, and a tutor who does not ask which tier your child is entered for has told you something.

Each Diploma subject also carries an Internal Assessment (IA), with the Extended Essay (EE) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) running alongside, and those three are where families most often want help late. We will match a tutor for internal assessment support, with a firm boundary: a tutor can shape a research question, teach how evidence is used and read a draft and say where it overreaches, and cannot write any part of it. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects a tutor in Altamount Road is asked for, that line does not move.

What we will not do is claim coverage we do not have in a given week. If no verified tutor is free for a particular subject and level at the time you need, we say so rather than offering a near-equivalent. Confirm the structure of your child's course with the school coordinator or the current subject guide, since the boards revise them on their own schedules and we would rather you trust the source than us.

sections.heading: Subjects we are asked for most on this stretch of Mumbai
paragraphs: Mathematics first, by a long way, then the sciences, then English and the humanities, then languages. Mathematics requests divide cleanly into two kinds. The first is fluency: a student who follows a worked example and cannot start a question that looks unfamiliar, which is an algebra and confidence problem and takes a term of steady work. The second is pace: a Higher Level student who understands everything and finishes nothing in the time allowed, which is a different intervention and often faster to fix.

Science requests are rarely about content. A Diploma Programme student who can recite a mechanism loses marks for explaining a trend instead of giving its cause, or for an investigation whose research question was never answerable in the weeks available. English requests are almost always the same diagnosis in different words: the student writes well and summarises where the criteria ask for analysis. Humanities requests are usually about sourcing evidence rather than offering an opinion. Language requests are the ones most likely to need a tutor from outside South Mumbai, since a less commonly taught language has a thin local pool.

The useful thing about those patterns is that they shorten the diagnosis. A tutor who has seen the same five failure modes repeatedly will spot which one your child is in during the first session rather than the third, and will say so plainly. What they should not do is start at chapter one of the syllabus, because the school has already taught it and re-teaching content is the easiest way to fill an hour without changing anything.

Where a family wants several subjects covered, we would rather arrange two tutors on a lighter schedule than stretch one across four. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai parents sometimes ask for does not exist, and a candidate claiming to be one has answered the question. Related pairs do work genuinely well, Mathematics with Physics, English with History, and we will suggest them where they fit.

sections.heading: Does IB Gram serve Altamount Road, Peddar Road and Tardeo?
paragraphs: Yes, and as a single catchment rather than as separate ones, because they genuinely are. Altamount Road is a short, steep line of towers with no study centre to walk to, so lessons happen inside the apartment and the tutor is a pre-cleared visitor. A tutor holding a weekly slot here will usually also teach in Peddar Road, Cumballa Hill and Tardeo, all minutes away, and can chain two lessons in one evening without touching a main road. That clustering is why IB Gram home tuition in Altamount Road holds a fixed slot through a full term rather than sliding into fortnightly.

We match within the island deliberately. South Mumbai is short-distance and slow: a tutor coming from Worli or Dadar covers very little ground and can still lose the evening at the Haji Ali and Peddar Road signals. The Coastal Road has made the Worli approach more predictable and Metro Line 3 has changed how tutors reach Cuffe Parade and Fort, and neither of them helps with the final climb. Grant Road is the nearest station, and a tutor arriving on the Western Line and taking a short rickshaw up often beats a tutor who left Bandra by car at the same time.

This is the part of the service that is geography rather than policy, and it is why we will sometimes say no. If a parent wants a specific tutor who lives in Kandivali for a 6pm Tuesday slot on Altamount Road, we will tell you it will not survive November rather than take the booking and let it decay into fortnightly. Searches for IB tutors near me in Altamount Road are pointing at exactly the right instinct.

The exception is scarcity, and it is a real one. For a thinly taught Higher Level subject or an unusual language, the right verified tutor may be in the Western Suburbs, Thane or outside Mumbai altogether, and then we propose weekly online lessons instead of a commute nobody will sustain. Some families already have an IB private tutor Altamount Road neighbours recommended and come to us only for a second subject, which is a perfectly sensible way to use this.
