faqs.question: Is IB Gram a tuition centre in Fort?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent matching platform with no premises, no classrooms and no batches. We verify tutors, match them against a brief, and stay involved for the review and any replacement. Lessons happen at your home or online at a time you and the tutor agree. There are reputable coaching centres in Mumbai that run group classes, and if a group rate for a group service is what you actually want, one of those will suit you better than we will. We would say so rather than place a one-to-one tutor.

faqs.question: Why would you refuse to place us with a tutor other families use?
faqs.answer: Because preparation is finite and this is a concentrated market. A tutor carrying several students at the same level in the same cohort spreads the same reading of mark schemes and scripts across all of them, and the newest student gets the least of it. When a tutor reaches that cap we offer a different verified profile, a different slot or an online specialist, and we tell you which. The alternative is placing you and letting the thinness become visible in February, when there is no time left to change.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to our Fort building for a weekday evening slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, and Fort is one of the easier addresses in South Mumbai to staff. The precinct sits between CSMT and Churchgate, so a tutor arrives on the Western, Central or Harbour Line and walks the last stretch without touching the road network. Driving is the weaker option here: streets are narrow and parking near the older buildings is difficult. Give us the building and nearest cross street, and tell us which entrance to use, because several of these buildings are heritage structures where the visitor desk and stairs work differently.

faqs.question: Will you tell other parents that we are using IB Gram?
faqs.answer: No. We do not name the families or children we work with, to anyone, and we do not tell you about other arrangements either, however much it might help you decide. In a cohort where most clients attend the same school this is an operational rule rather than a policy statement. Your brief, your address and your child's marked work go only to the tutor you approve. If a platform volunteers information about another family to you, assume it volunteers information about you to them.

faqs.question: Can two neighbouring families share one tutor and split the cost?
faqs.answer: We decline shared lessons, and in this locality the request comes up often. A lesson taught to two children pitches at the middle and short-changes both, particularly when their gaps differ, which they almost always do even within one class. There are also real confidentiality problems when two families from the same cohort sit in one room. What we do arrange regularly is two consecutive one-to-one slots at one address, which saves the tutor a journey and sometimes affects what they charge, without blending the teaching.

faqs.question: Do we pay IB Gram or the tutor?
faqs.answer: The tutor. Lessons are arranged and paid directly between your family and the tutor, so there is no package, no prepaid hours, no registration fee and no notice period if you stop. Nothing is held with us, which removes any financial pressure to continue with a match you doubt. The discovery call costs nothing and a replacement shortlist costs nothing. If you leave we would ask one question, which is whether the problem was travel, subject depth or rapport, because those need three different replacements.

faqs.question: What if we cannot get the evening slot we want?
faqs.answer: You have four options and we will set them out rather than substitute quietly. Move the slot, since a Saturday morning or a later weekday start often opens up the specialist you actually wanted. Take an online specialist in the same subject. Take a different verified tutor who has capacity, which is frequently better than it sounds. Or wait, which in a quiet term can beat paying for six lessons aimed at the wrong gap. Popular evening slots across this cohort are generally committed by late August.

faqs.question: How quickly can a replacement tutor start?
faqs.answer: Usually within a few days for a common subject, and longer for a scarce one. What speeds it up is the handover pack: the session-one diagnosis in writing, a record of coverage and the current next step. With those, a new tutor begins where the last one stopped. Without them, the first two sessions are spent rediscovering what was already known, which is why we ask every tutor to put the diagnosis in writing at the start. Request it in week one rather than when you need it.

faqs.question: Does somebody need to be at home during the lesson?
faqs.answer: For students under about fourteen, someone should be in the flat though not in the room. For Diploma-age students neither is necessary. What matters more is the space: a table the tutor can sit beside, enough light to read marked scripts and diagrams, and the phone somewhere else. Tell us in the brief who will be present, because the tutor needs to know who to report to after the session. In many Fort flats the dining table works better than a bedroom, since papers can be spread out.

faqs.question: When should we send a brief if the exams are a year away?
faqs.answer: August or September, and the reason is capacity rather than urgency. Evening slots across this cohort are committed early, so a brief sent in October chooses from what remains, and a brief sent in late January arrives in the same fortnight as everybody else's. Starting early also gives a diagnosis two full terms to act on. If you expect to want a second weekly slot during mocks, say so in your first message and the tutor will hold the capacity for you.

faqs.question: What if the tutor and the school teach a method differently?
faqs.answer: The school's method wins, because the school marks the work. This surfaces most often in mathematical notation and in essay structure, and it unsettles students more than either adult expects. A good tutor teaches the school's approach and may privately prefer another, which is fine. A tutor who insists on their own against the teacher's is handing your child a problem to carry into an examination. Tell us if it persists and we will raise it with the tutor directly if you would rather not have that conversation yourself.

faqs.question: Will you tell us if we should not hire a tutor at all?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we have done it in these streets and lost the enquiry. If a timetable is already full, another evening commitment usually makes the term worse rather than better. If the school's comments concern effort, attendance or missed deadlines rather than skill, the useful conversation is with the school. If there is an unaddressed learning need, the right professional is a specialist rather than a subject tutor. And if a child's own scripts show steady improvement and the only problem is the class ranking, a tutor will find little to fix.

paragraphs: You send a brief, we shortlist, you interview, you decide. IB Gram is an independent matching service, so we do not employ tutors, run batches or sell packages of sessions. The tutor you choose sets their own rate and you deal with them directly for lessons; our part is finding the two or three people who actually fit and checking them before they reach you. Most Four Bungalows enquiries become a shortlist within a day or two for common subjects.

The second version lets us filter on subject, level, deadline and travel at once. Families who write that much usually meet the right tutor on the first call rather than the third.

sections.heading: Which programmes and levels IB Gram covers in Mumbai
paragraphs: The Primary Years Programme (PYP), the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and the Diploma Programme (DP), across the full year range families in this area need, plus the Cambridge International Education and Pearson Edexcel routes that many of the same schools run alongside them. What matters more than the list is that each programme is matched separately: we do not treat a PYP request and a Diploma Higher Level (HL) request as the same job with different content.

For PYP the request is usually reading fluency, number sense and the confidence to speak in a unit of inquiry, and the right arrangement is short and frequent. For MYP it is criterion literacy: understanding that work is judged against four published criteria per subject, and that a response improves by changing its structure rather than its length. For the Diploma Programme it is subject command plus sequencing, because a DP2 student in December is carrying coursework in several subjects at once.

Level matters as much as programme. Higher Level and Standard Level (SL) need different pacing and sometimes different tutors, and a Higher Level specialist can pitch badly to a Standard Level student without either of them realising why the sessions feel discouraging. When you send a brief, name the level. If the level is still undecided, say that too, because a conversation with somebody who has taught both is the cheapest useful hour available at that point.

We do not reproduce paper structures, component weightings, durations or mark totals anywhere on this site, and nor should a tutor quote them from memory. The International Baccalaureate and the examination boards revise subject guides on their own cycles, so the authoritative source is your school's current guide or the programme coordinator. A tutor arranging IB Gram home tuition in Four Bungalows should be telling you to check with the school rather than telling you what the paper looks like.

sections.heading: One specialist per subject: how IB Gram handles subject requests
paragraphs: We match one tutor per subject, and we will say so plainly when a family asks for one person to cover several. No single person covers all IB and IGCSE subjects any tutor in Four Bungalows might list on a profile, and the ones who claim it are telling you something about themselves. Our enquiry list spans all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes Four Bungalows parents ask for, from early literacy to Higher Level sciences, and it is filled by many specialists rather than a few generalists.

Some requests we fill from inside this pocket within a day or two: Mathematics, the sciences at Standard Level, English, Hindi and the commerce subjects. Others are thin across the whole city and take longer: Higher Level sciences with real internal assessment experience, Economics and Business Management at Higher Level, Computer Science, Visual Arts, Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay coaching, and languages beyond Hindi, French and Spanish. We say which group your request falls into at the start rather than letting you wait hopefully.

Where a subject is genuinely scarce, we offer the honest options instead of a nearer substitute. Those are a tutor travelling from further away at a slot that suits their journey, an online specialist, or a hybrid pattern. What we will not do is put forward somebody who has never taught the level because they happen to live nearby, since that choice costs a term and the family rarely finds out until mocks. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai households accumulate does not exist, and pretending otherwise is the commonest dishonesty in this market.

For coursework we hold a fixed boundary and tutors are told it before they are shortlisted. A tutor may question a research question until it is narrow enough to answer, point at published criteria, ask why a method was chosen and press on whether assumptions were tested. A tutor may not draft text, supply data, edit a report or make journal entries, and must respect whatever limits your school sets on outside help. Ask your school what those limits are and tell us; we will pass it on.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram work around the Mumbai school calendar?
paragraphs: By asking for the school, not just the board, in every brief. Children on this stretch of JP Road attend several international schools rather than one, with JBCN International School, Oshiwara taking a large share and Billabong High International School taking others. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with either school, or with any school named on this page. We ask because mock weeks, coursework deadlines and tier or level decisions are scheduled inside the school, not by the board.

That has a practical consequence for matching. A tutor already carrying three students from one school will have no capacity in exactly the fortnight those students' tasks are due, so we check a tutor's existing load against your school's calendar before shortlisting them. It is an unglamorous piece of filtering and it prevents the commonest scheduling failure, which is a tutor who was available in October and is firefighting in January.

Daily timing we handle by asking for arrival times rather than preferred times. Children get back to Four Bungalows between four and five-thirty depending on day and route, and nearly every family then asks for seven o'clock, which makes it the scarcest hour in Andheri West. Weekend mornings also allow a two-hour block, which suits timed paper work far better than a tired weeknight hour.

For the monsoon we ask for a decision in advance rather than in the moment. The agreement we recommend is simple: a washed-out week becomes an online session and the slot is kept. sections.heading: Home classes first, with online and hybrid as real options in Mumbai
paragraphs: Home tuition is our lead service and it is the default we propose, because a tutor in the room sees the working as it is written, notices when a student stops, and can point at a line on the page. In Four Bungalows it is also the easiest thing to sustain, since the tutor's journey ends at a metro station rather than in Link Road traffic. Most of the home classes we arrange in Mumbai for this pocket are one weekly hour at a fixed time, in the flat, on a table with a closed door.

Online is offered where it is genuinely better rather than where it is easier for us. A scarce subject with no qualified tutor within reach. A monsoon week that would otherwise be cancelled. Short revision check-ins where fifteen minutes now beats an hour next week. And a self-managing DP2 student whose need is their own drafts interrogated rather than content taught. In each of those cases we say why we are proposing it, and we ask for a document camera or a writing tablet where the subject needs visible working.

We decline some online bookings and it is worth knowing in advance. Online is the wrong choice for a young student who stops writing when nobody is watching, and it is the wrong choice in a flat with no quiet corner, which is a more common constraint than families admit. If a parent wants to try anyway we will say what we expect to happen and suggest a three-session review rather than a term, so that nobody discovers it in week ten.

Hybrid is what most of our longer arrangements here become, and we would rather plan it than let it happen. One in-person session a week for teaching and live marking, plus one shorter online session for feedback on work the student did alone. It keeps weekly contact unbroken through the rains, school trips and the tutor's own travel, and it usually costs less in total travel. For a Diploma Programme student in the second year, the online half is often the more valuable one.

sections.heading: What does IB Gram check, and what is left to you?
paragraphs: We check three things and you check two, and the division is deliberate. On our side: government photo identity verified against the name on the profile, the degree or teaching qualification claimed, and a stated record of teaching the specific board, programme and level, with dates rather than vague duration. We ask when they last taught it, because somebody who taught a syllabus several revisions ago is not currently a specialist in it, however good they once were.

We also ask every candidate a scenario question before shortlisting them, and the answer carries real weight. The scenario is a named struggling student, for instance a DP1 whose Mathematics grade has fallen from a 6 to a 4 in one term. The answer we want involves the last marked paper and getting the student to talk through two wrong answers. The answer that worries us involves a syllabus checklist and starting from the basics. That one question sorts candidates faster than any document.

What is left to you is fit and travel, because neither can be verified from a form. On the free discovery call, ask what they are teaching this term and at which level, what the first thirty minutes will look like, what you will receive after four weeks, how a missed session is handled and whether the slot is held, and where they travel from on which days. Then ask your child, if they are over about twelve, which of the two candidates they would rather work with.

One claim to refuse outright, whoever makes it. Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, because nobody can know that, and IB Gram does not guarantee grades either. The softer versions are easier to miss: a promised criterion level, a confident prediction of a particular score, a success rate with no source. All of those are the same claim in different clothing. We do not allow them in a profile and you should treat them as a reason to decline on a call.

sections.heading: What does IB Gram not do?
paragraphs: We do not guarantee grades, publish success rates, rank tutors against each other, run batches or centres, write or edit coursework, or claim any affiliation with the schools named on this page. We also do not sell session packages, which means there is nothing to buy upfront and nothing to unwind if a match does not work. Those are not caveats added at the bottom of a page; they are the shape of the service, and they explain why the process looks the way it does.

We do not employ the tutors either, and that distinction matters to you in two practical ways. The rate is set by the tutor, so you negotiate it with them on the discovery call rather than with us, and it varies with the programme and level, the scarcity of the subject, their experience, the session length and the travel involved. And the teaching relationship is theirs, so a tutor who is punctual, prepared and honest with you is being so on their own account rather than to meet a quota.

We also decline work. A booking we think is wrong gets a conversation rather than an invoice: online lessons for a young child who needs somebody physically present, one tutor stretched across two programmes, three subjects started simultaneously in March, or coursework support beyond what a school permits. Saying no to those costs us a booking and saves a family a term, and it is the clearest test of whether a matching service is working for you or for itself.

What we do instead is narrow. We find and check tutors, put forward two or three, arrange the calls, and then step back and ask you every two to four weeks whether it is working. If the answer is no, we replace the tutor without a switching fee. That is the whole offer, and IB Gram home tuition in Four Bungalows is simply that offer applied to one pocket of Andheri West where the metro makes the logistics unusually straightforward.

sections.heading: Reviews, replacements and the honest limits of IB Gram home classes
paragraphs: The review is a conversation, not a form, and it happens on a schedule so it does not depend on a parent feeling brave enough to complain. We come back after the first fortnight and then every two to four weeks, and we ask three questions: is the tutor arriving on time, can you name something your child can now do that they could not before, and is there anything you would change. Most problems surface on the second question, and most of them are fixable.

Replacement works without drama because nothing is locked in. Tell us what specifically is not landing and we either ask the tutor to change approach, which works when the issue is pacing or the balance between explaining and writing, or we put forward a different profile. There is no switching fee and no notice period imposed by us. The one thing we press parents on is timing: raise it at four weeks rather than in March, because a comfortable arrangement that is not working will drift for a whole term if nobody says so.

What progress should look like is worth stating so you can hold us to it. At four weeks, a diagnosis you recognise, three named priorities and one demonstrable change, not a grade. At one term, fewer repeated errors in marked work and a named list of secure and fragile topics. Over an exam cycle, the habits: reading the command term, showing method, sitting sections to the clock and self-marking against the real criteria. Those are the things that show up when it matters.

The limits are plain and we would rather put them here than in a footer. IB Gram does not guarantee grades and publishes no success rates. Tutoring cannot compress two years of Higher Level content into eight weeks, cannot substitute for attending school, cannot do a student's coursework, and cannot repair a badly chosen subject combination, though it can make one survivable. Anyone who tells you otherwise about IB home tuition in Four Bungalows or anywhere else in Mumbai is selling rather than teaching.

sections.heading: Getting IB Gram home tuition started in Four Bungalows, Mumbai
paragraphs: Send six things and the first conversation takes ten minutes: the school and year group, the programme, the subject and level or tier, a photograph of the last marked paper, the time your child gets home, and two or three evening windows your flat can host. Add the society or building name and whether a visitor pass is needed, and the first session starts on time instead of at the gate.

You will get two or three profiles with a free discovery call each. Use the same questions with all of them and compare the answers rather than the manner: what are you teaching this term and at which level, what happens in the first thirty minutes, what will I receive after four weeks, how is a missed session handled, and where do you travel from. Then choose, and tell us who you chose so we know whose arrangement to review.

Session one is a diagnosis and should not feel like a lesson. The tutor spends the opening half hour on the marked work, asking your child to talk through two answers that lost marks, working out whether the cause is content, method, reading the question or time. By the end they should name three priorities in plain language and estimate how long each takes. Parents occasionally find this underwhelming; it is the hour that tells you whether the next twenty are worth buying.

After that it is a fixed weekly slot, a short written note from the tutor each time, and our review every two to four weeks. Nothing is locked in and no package is bought upfront. Some families arrive from a search for an IB home tutor in Four Bungalows, some from IB tuition fees in Four Bungalows, some from an IB private tutor Four Bungalows query and some from a plain IB tutor Mumbai search, and a few from best IB tutor in Four Bungalows. They all get the same process, because it is the only one we run.

Send the brief whenever it is ready, including mid-term, including during exam season and including in the middle of the monsoon. The families in Andheri West who contact us a term before they feel they need to are consistently the ones with the calmest spring, mainly because the good tutors in a scarce subject are gone by January. IB Gram home tuition in Four Bungalows starts with one message and costs nothing until you have chosen somebody.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram serve Four Bungalows, and which nearby areas?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the same tutor pool covers Seven Bungalows, Lokhandwala and the wider Andheri West area. Four Bungalows is one of the easier pockets in this suburb to staff, because DN Nagar metro sits at one end of JP Road and tutors do not have to budget for Link Road traffic, so a tutor who does not drive is still viable. We tend to place Lokhandwala sessions earlier in the evening, since the roads near the market congest from about seven, and keep later slots for Four Bungalows.

faqs.question: What does IB Gram charge, and what do fees depend on?
faqs.answer: The tutor sets the rate and you agree it with them directly on the discovery call. It varies with the programme and level, how scarce the subject is, the tutor's experience, the session length and the travel involved, which is why we publish no price list that would be wrong for most enquiries. There is no package to buy upfront and no joining fee for the matching itself. Agree the rate, the session length and what happens to a cancelled session before the first lesson rather than after it.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get a tutor after we send a brief?
faqs.answer: Usually a day or two for a shortlist in common subjects, and longer for scarce ones such as Higher Level option subjects or less common languages, where the pool is thin across the whole city rather than just this suburb. The slowest part is often fitting the discovery calls around work and school. If a deadline is driving the urgency, say so in the brief and we will prioritise availability over the ideal match, and tell you that is what we are doing.

faqs.question: Can a tutor travel to our building on JP Road for an evening slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we ask about your gate before the first session rather than after it. Most societies here will add a regular weekly visitor to a standing list if a resident asks at the office, which removes the commonest reason a session starts fifteen minutes late. Give us the society name, wing and flat number exactly as the gate records them, plus whether a pass is needed. Ten minutes lost at a gate each week is a serious amount of teaching across a school year.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out?
faqs.answer: Tell us at the two-week or four-week review and we replace them, with no switching fee and no notice period from us. Describe what specifically is not landing, because the detail changes the response: a pacing problem or too much explaining and too little writing can often be fixed with the same tutor, while a personality mismatch is quicker to solve with a different profile. Raise it early. A polite, punctual, ineffective arrangement will drift for a whole term if nobody says anything.

faqs.question: Does somebody need to be at home during a session?
faqs.answer: An adult in the flat is enough and they need not be in the room. The useful habit is being free for five minutes at the end so the tutor can say what was covered and what to practise, or asking for two written lines if you get home late. Arrangements where no adult ever speaks to the tutor drift, because the only feedback loop is the child's own account. A table with a closed door and no television audible matters more than most families expect.

faqs.question: Can IB Gram arrange tutors for two children on different boards?
faqs.answer: Yes, as two separate matches on one shared schedule. Send both children in one message with both their school arrival times, and we will try to place the tutors on adjacent evenings or back-to-back on the same evening so your household loses one disrupted window rather than two. The two arrangements stay independent: separate tutors, separate rates, separate reviews, so changing one does not disturb the other. In Four Bungalows the metro makes two fixed slots on one evening genuinely workable.

faqs.question: Will the same tutor stay for the whole year?
faqs.answer: Usually, and that continuity is worth protecting, which is why we match on travel realism rather than on enthusiasm. The arrangements that break mid-year are nearly always the ones where the journey was always marginal and nobody admitted it, or where no monsoon fallback was agreed. If a tutor does have to stop, for their own exams, a job change or a move, we shortlist a replacement and share what the previous tutor had diagnosed so the new one does not start from zero.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram help with coursework like an Internal Assessment?
faqs.answer: Within a fixed boundary that we state to tutors before shortlisting them. A tutor may question a research question until it is narrow enough to answer properly, point at the published criteria, ask why a method was chosen and press on whether assumptions were tested. A tutor may not draft text, supply data, edit a report or make journal entries, and must respect whatever limits your school sets on outside help. Ask the school what those limits are and tell us, and we will pass it to the tutor.

faqs.question: Is IB Gram affiliated with any school in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with JBCN International School, Oshiwara, with Billabong High International School, or with any other school, nor with the International Baccalaureate Organization, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. We name schools on these pages only as local context, because their calendars determine when assessment pressure arrives and therefore how tutoring is scheduled in this part of Andheri West. Any tutor claiming a school affiliation on our behalf is misrepresenting us.

faqs.question: What if we only want a few sessions before an exam?
faqs.answer: That is a legitimate and underused request, and we match for it. A bounded engagement, for example six sessions of timed paper practice before mocks or a handful of sessions around an Internal Assessment deadline, is often the best value tutoring a family buys in a year. Say in the brief that it is short and bounded, because it changes which tutors are suitable: some prefer a long-term arrangement, while others are glad of defined work. Agree the end point with the tutor at the start.

faqs.question: How do you handle holidays and missed sessions?
faqs.answer: You agree that with the tutor directly, and we recommend settling it in the first conversation rather than the first time it happens. The three points to cover are how much notice a cancellation needs, whether a long absence is paid, partly paid or unpaid, and whether the slot is held during it. Practice varies between tutors and we do not impose a policy. For breaks of a week or two, some families keep one short online session going so a Diploma Programme student does not lose momentum.

paragraphs: The International Baccalaureate (IB) across all three stages, and the Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel international qualifications that sit alongside them. In practice that means Primary Years Programme (PYP) support where the need is reading, numeracy and work habits; Middle Years Programme (MYP) Years 1 to 5, where the work is criterion technique; and Diploma Programme (DP) Years 1 and 2, where it is examination technique, internal assessments and the Extended Essay (EE). On the Cambridge side it means International General Certificate of Secondary Education subjects at Core and Extended tiers, and the Pearson Edexcel equivalents.

What matters more than the list is how the matching treats it. A request is never filled by somebody who teaches the subject generally; it is filled by somebody who has taught that board at that level, and the profile says which. Families often ask for all IB and IGCSE subjects a tutor in Ghatkopar East can cover, and the honest answer is that no single tutor covers them well. A household with a Year 4 Middle Years Programme student and a second-year Diploma Programme student will usually end up with two tutors, often on different evenings, and that is the correct outcome rather than a failure of the service.

Where IB Gram is weakest is worth stating plainly, because it saves everybody time. Rare second languages, specialist arts subjects and some Higher Level options have thin local pools, and for those the realistic answer is an online specialist rather than IB home tuition in Ghatkopar East. If the pool cannot be staffed well in this area, you will be told that rather than sent a weak profile with confident wording. paragraphs: Mathematics and the sciences most readily, then English language and literature, then individuals and societies, then everything else with more notice. Mathematics is the most requested subject in this neighbourhood and also the best staffed, which is why a request made in July is usually filled from a genuine choice of three. Higher Level physics and chemistry are staffable here but the pool is narrower, and it narrows further after August.

The subject that surprises parents is English. Requests tend to come from families whose child reads constantly and still underperforms, which is a technique problem rather than a reading problem: analytical writing against assessment criteria is a learned structure, and it responds quickly to a tutor who marks essays rather than discusses them. Individuals and societies requests are usually about source evaluation and answering the question set. Design, arts and physical and health education requests are rare and take longer to fill.

Second languages are where expectation management matters most. Students who join a school mid-cycle land in a language phase built on years of prior study, and that needs a tutor who understands phase placement rather than a general language teacher. A tutor making a single journey for one hour is doing you a favour in June and quietly rescheduling by October. Ghatkopar station does a lot of the work. So the routing is often the opposite of what the map suggests, and a tutor driving down JVLR from Powai or Chandivali reaches your door before one who took Metro Line 1 and then crossed from the station.

sections.heading: How IB Gram plans around the Mumbai school calendar
paragraphs: By asking which school before asking which subject, because the school decides the dates everything else hangs on. Mumbai schools open the academic year in late June or July. The first serious internal assessments land in August and September, mocks fall in December or January depending on the school, and written papers sit in the first half of the calendar year for most candidates. Internal assessment and project deadlines differ between schools by weeks, so two families in the same building can have crises two months apart.

That is why the brief asks for the school name. Children around here attending Witty International School or Hiranandani Foundation School work to different internal calendars, and a tutor planning a term without knowing which one is planning in the abstract. Bus timing is the second reason: a child travelling back from a school in Powai arrives home later than a classmate attending one in Chembur, which is frequently the difference between a six and a seven o'clock slot being possible at all. Tell us both and the shortlist is built around them.

IB Gram is not affiliated with those schools, holds no arrangement with them, and is not affiliated with the IB Organization, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel either. They are named because their timetables determine which evenings exist for families in this part of Mumbai. The practical advice that follows from the calendar is unwelcome and true: brief early. paragraphs: Yes, but home tuition is the lead service and that ordering is deliberate rather than traditional. A tutor in the room sees attention go, sees the diagram drawn wrongly, sees a question abandoned quietly, and those are the observations the first month is actually for. The home classes we arrange in Mumbai open with the student working something cold while the tutor watches the page rather than the final answer. Most families here run home sessions as the backbone of the arrangement and use online for specific work rather than as a substitute.

Online earns its place in three situations and IB Gram will recommend it in them. When the subject pool in this area genuinely cannot be staffed well, an online specialist beats a weak local match every time. When the student is a self-managing Diploma Programme candidate needing one narrow specialism. And for document work, since essay drafts, data analysis and project feedback are easier on a shared screen than on paper. An IB online tutor in Ghatkopar East is the wrong recommendation for a Year 9 student who cannot yet work alone for twenty minutes, and you will be told that rather than sold the session.

Hybrid is what most families settle into by the second term: one session at home each week for teaching and marked work, one shorter online slot for review or feedback. It survives the monsoon, survives a tutor's exam-season travel and keeps the rhythm when the Eastern Express Highway is crawling near Vikhroli. The split goes into the plan at the discovery call rather than drifting into existence, including who initiates the online call. sections.heading: What IB Gram checks, and what it leaves to you
paragraphs: Three checks happen before any profile reaches a parent. Government photo identity is matched against the name on the profile. Qualifications and teaching claims are checked against documents rather than accepted as stated. And every tutor is interviewed on a live subject question, which is the check that does the real work, because the gap between knowing a subject and being able to mark it against a published scheme is wide and invisible on paper. The profile then states which board, programme and level the tutor has actually taught, and that is the line to read first.

What is left to you is fit, and it cannot be delegated. The discovery call is where you establish whether this person suits this child. Ask which board and level they last taught and in which academic year. Ask what they would do in session one with the marked paper in front of you. Ask whether marking happens between sessions and whether you will see it. Ask what they will not take on, because a tutor who names a limit is more reliable than one who accepts everything without pausing.

One check is non-negotiable from the IB Gram side. Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade; IB Gram does not guarantee grades and any tutor making that claim is removed rather than coached. There is also a practical layer worth settling on the same call. Can the tutor produce identity at the society gate so entry becomes routine. Can they hold one evening for a full term. paragraphs: No grades, no success rates, no rankings and no claims about how many students have passed anything. Any service quoting a success percentage is either counting something it chose after the fact or has simply made the number up. What can reasonably be expected inside four weeks is specific. A written diagnosis naming habits rather than topics. Marked work in your child's own hand showing one habit beginning to change. A grade change is not on that list, and a tutor who offers one at four weeks is telling you they do not understand how the assessments work. At one term, the fair measure is timed past-paper performance on material taught in that term.

There is also a limit worth stating about the service rather than the tutors. The pages that promise otherwise are the ones to be cautious of. Depth is not uniform across all of it, and we say so before you choose rather than after.

Where a programme is less commonly taught in this part of Mumbai, the honest position is that the shortlist may take longer to assemble or may be online rather than in person. PYP support in particular is thinner than DP support everywhere in the city, because fewer tutors specialise in it and fewer parents look for it. If we cannot staff your request from the island within a reasonable time, we will tell you that instead of sending a profile that is approximately right. A plausible shortlist is worse than a slow one.

The programme also determines what the tutoring is actually for, and that shapes the brief. A DP2 request is usually about examination technique, internal assessment deadlines and triage. An MYP request is usually about criterion-based marking and work habits. An IGCSE Year 10 request often turns out to be about the Core or Extended tier decision rather than about content at all. Say which of those three your worry resembles and the shortlist tightens considerably. For the current structure of any subject or programme, your school's coordinator is the authority.

sections.heading: Subjects we can staff here, and ones we cannot
paragraphs: Mathematics, the sciences, Economics, Business Management, English and the Individuals and Societies group are the requests we can usually fill from within the island at short notice. Languages vary sharply: Hindi and Marathi are straightforward, French and Spanish are workable, and less commonly taught language options can take weeks or resolve to an online tutor rather than a home one. Visual Arts and Design sit somewhere in between, and Music is genuinely difficult to staff for home tuition anywhere in Mumbai.

Subject choice itself is part of what a good tutor discusses, and the decisions behind it carry real consequences. In the Diploma Programme the HL and SL split sets both a ceiling and a workload; in IGCSE the Core and Extended tier decision does the same thing earlier. Each DP subject also carries its own internal assessment, and those pieces do not distribute themselves politely across the year. A student taking three sciences at Higher Level has three internal assessments plus the Extended Essay and the TOK essay, and the drafting windows overlap. Sequencing that is a skill separate from subject knowledge.

When you send a brief naming several subjects, expect us to suggest splitting it. One tutor who claims eight subjects across both boards is overstating, and a profile that covers all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes Girgaon families might ever ask for does not exist. Two specialists with a shared understanding of the workload beat one generalist stretched thin, and it usually costs less in wasted sessions. We will say which subject we think is the priority and why, and you are free to disagree.

sections.heading: Can home classes in Girgaon switch to online mid-term?
paragraphs: Yes, and it is the most common adjustment we make. Home tuition is the lead service and the default for a reason: a tutor in the room sees the exercise book, the school's annotations and the moment a student's attention goes. But a term is long, and weeks happen when nobody should be travelling. A monsoon evening, an illness in the house, a school trip, an exam week when the student is at home all day anyway. Switching those weeks online keeps the habit alive instead of cancelling.

Girgaon's older chawl-and-building mix means study space varies a lot home to home, so the first session here is often spent agreeing where lessons will actually happen, and that decision affects the online question too. A family with one shared room may find online sessions harder than home ones, because the tutor's physical presence is what makes the rest of the household treat the hour as protected. Another family with a small study may find online works perfectly. We ask rather than assume, which is why the question appears on the brief.

A permanent switch to an IB online tutor in Girgaon makes sense in two situations. When the subject specialist you need genuinely does not exist on the island, which happens with less commonly taught languages and some Higher Level options. And when the student is old enough to work independently and the family would rather have a better tutor on a screen than an adequate one in the room. Both are legitimate. What we will not do is quietly move you online because staffing a home slot turned out to be difficult, and you should ask the question directly if a shortlist arrives online-only.

sections.heading: What happens after you send the brief?
paragraphs: Within the first exchange we will come back either with questions or with a timeline. If the request is mainstream, a shortlist usually follows quickly. If it is a scarce subject, a late weekday slot or a programme with thin local depth, we say how long we think it will take rather than sending something approximate to look responsive. The discovery call is twenty minutes or so, and it is not a sales call. We are not on it. You speak to the tutor directly, with your child present if they will join, and you ask whatever you want, including what they charge and how they handle a student who will not do the work between sessions. If you do not want to proceed with any of the profiles, say so and we will go back and shortlist again. That has no cost and no consequence, and it happens often enough that we build it into the process rather than treating it as failure.

After lessons start, the arrangement is between you and the tutor for scheduling and payment, and we stay in it for the review. At two to four weeks we ask you three questions: is the slot holding, has the tutor shown you what they found and prioritised, and what does your child say about the sessions. That third answer is the one parents least expect to be asked and the one that most often reveals a mismatch. A missed session is rearranged between you and the tutor directly; a pattern of missed sessions is something we want to hear about, because it usually means the travel or the time was wrong from the start.

sections.heading: What IB Gram does not promise
paragraphs: We do not guarantee grades, and we do not allow tutors on the platform to suggest otherwise to you or to your child. We do not publish success rates, student counts or testimonial scores, because figures like those cannot be verified by a parent and exist to reassure rather than to inform. We do not claim a relationship with any school. And we do not promise a tutor will be available at any particular hour until we have actually found one who can hold it, which is why some briefs come back with a timeline instead of a shortlist.

What is reasonable to expect is more modest and more checkable. At four weeks, a tutor should be able to tell you what they found in the diagnosis, which two or three things they prioritised, what your child can now do that they could not in week one, and what is still outstanding. At one term, foundation gaps should have stopped being the reason marks are lost. School assessments in the targeted subject often move in the second term rather than the first, because early gains sit in technique while tests reward coverage. Across a full examination cycle, the honest claim is that technique stops costing marks.

When a tutor is not working out, the mechanism is simple and there is no lock-in to argue about. Tell us what is happening in the room. Sometimes the answer is a change of approach, and we will ask the tutor for it. When it is a change of person, we return to the shortlist, arrange fresh discovery calls and you choose again exactly as you did the first time. We would rather replace a tutor in week three than hear in month four that a family stopped a term they had already paid for and said nothing.

faqs.question: Can you help with the Extended Essay or an internal assessment?

A tutor cannot write, edit or supply any part of it, and one willing to do that is creating an academic honesty problem rather than solving an academic one. Ask each shortlisted tutor where they draw that line before lessons begin, and treat a clear answer as reassuring.

faqs.answer: Group classes teach a syllabus at a fixed pace to whoever enrolled; home tuition teaches one student at the pace their gaps require. For IB and IGCSE students the difference matters most on internal assessments and command terms, which are individual pieces of work and cannot be taught to a room. Group classes can be the better choice when a student is broadly fine and wants structured practice. They are a poor choice when the problem is specific and personal, which is what most parents are describing when they get in touch.

sections.heading: Where the programme structure actually changes the tutoring
paragraphs: A single school running the full IB continuum means families here move through three quite different assessment worlds without changing buildings. The Primary Years Programme (PYP) has no external examinations and reports on transdisciplinary units, so tuition at that stage is about reading fluency, number sense and the habit of asking a question rather than guessing. The Middle Years Programme (MYP) marks against published criteria strands, so the skill a tutor teaches is making the thinking visible on the page. The Diploma Programme (DP) is externally examined with internally assessed components, and the skill shifts again towards timing, precision and sustained written argument.

The transition that catches most families is MYP 5 into DP Year 1. A student who scored well against MYP criteria can land in a Higher Level subject and find that the same effort produces a four. The reason is rarely ability. It is that MYP rewards process shown in full while DP papers reward a correct, compact answer under time pressure, and nobody tells a fifteen-year-old that the rules have changed. A good DP tutor spends the first month on that translation rather than on new content, and parents should expect exactly that.

Cambridge IGCSE exists in this corridor too, with Witty International School among the local Cambridge options, so households with two children can be running both systems at once. Under Cambridge the live decision is Core or Extended tier, and it belongs to the school: the department decides entry and the examinations officer confirms it. A home tutor's legitimate role is making Extended survivable for a student already entered for it, and giving the department real evidence that the student is coping. Promising to move a child between tiers is promising something a tutor does not control.

The practical reading of your child's report tells you which world you are in. Criterion letters mean MYP. Subject levels and predicted grades out of seven mean the DP. Tier codes and syllabus numbers mean Cambridge IGCSE. Bring that report to the discovery call. sections.heading: Subject choice across both boards, and the internal assessment behind each
paragraphs: The internally assessed component is where subject choice becomes real, because it is the part of the course a student cannot cram. Diploma Programme Mathematics requires an exploration: an individual piece of mathematical writing on a self-chosen topic, where the commonest failure is choosing something too broad to analyse. The sciences require a scientific investigation, and the commonest failure is a research question that cannot be answered by the method the student actually ran. Economics requires commentaries built on published articles, where the failure is picking an article the course tools cannot touch.

Group 1 and Group 2 subjects work differently and are frequently underestimated at the point of choosing. English A carries oral and written assessed tasks that reward close reading of how a text is built, so a student who summarises plot confidently will still score poorly. Language B rewards productive fluency under time pressure, which is practised out loud and is a genuine argument for a tutor in the room rather than a screen. Families choosing a Higher Level subject because of a rumour about university admissions should test the choice against one real past paper before Year 11 ends.

At Cambridge IGCSE the depth question is about papers and precision. Science candidates sit theory papers plus, in most Mumbai schools, the alternative-to-practical route, which asks a student to reason about method, variables and a results table in writing. Mathematics at Extended tier rewards clean legible working more than clever shortcuts. Business and Economics reward answers that use the stimulus material instead of recited definitions. A tutor should be marking against the published scheme with your child watching the mark allocation, not awarding encouraging marks.

This page deliberately does not state weightings, paper lengths or mark totals, and you should treat any tutor who recites them from memory with some caution. The IB and Cambridge International Education revise their subject guides on their own cycles, and a structure that held three years ago may not hold for the session your child sits. The authority is the current subject guide and your school's coordinator. We take requests across all IB and IGCSE subjects and the tutor in Goregaon East we put forward is a specialist in one or two of them, not a claimed expert in twelve.

sections.heading: Goregaon East, Powai and the JVLR crossing
paragraphs: Goregaon East hangs between the Western Express Highway and JVLR, which gives it an unusual property for a Western Suburbs address: it is genuinely reachable from the Central Suburbs. Powai has no station of its own, so Powai tutors already travel by road, and the JVLR run across to Goregaon East is one they make anyway. That widens the pool here in a way that does not apply to Malad West or Kandivali. When we staff IB Gram home tuition in Goregaon East we look both west along the Western Line and east across JVLR, which is unusual for this zone.

Jogeshwari sits immediately south and shares both the station catchment and the highway, so a tutor with a Monday in Jogeshwari and a Wednesday in Goregaon East is running a tight week. Malad East is one stop north along the Western Line and behaves similarly. Powai is the outlier: closer in minutes than its map position suggests off-peak, and considerably further at six in the evening when JVLR backs up towards the highway. A tutor who promises a 6pm arrival from Powai in October has usually not driven it in October.

The wider rule in the Western Suburbs of Mumbai is to match along the line rather than across the city. Everything moves north and south on the Western Line and the Western Express Highway, with Metro Lines 2A and 7 now carrying the Dahisar to Gundavali load and Metro Line 1 running east to Ghatkopar. Bandra to Andheri is quick off-peak and slow at six. Khar to Santacruz or Malad to Kandivali holds across a term. Pulling a tutor from South Mumbai for a weekday evening in Goregaon East does not, however willing they are in week one.

Inside the Oberoi Garden City cluster there is one piece of local arithmetic worth knowing. Because Oberoi Splendor, Oberoi Esquire and Oberoi Exquisite sit close together with a shared approach, a tutor can hold two or even three slots in one evening without travelling between them. If you are flexible about the exact hour, say so: a family willing to take 8pm after the tutor's 6.30pm in the next tower often gets a specialist who would otherwise have been unavailable. sections.heading: Home classes, online lessons, or both for a Goregaon East family?
paragraphs: Home tuition stays the default, and in a tower cluster it has a practical advantage beyond teaching quality: the tutor is already in the building. A child who knows a specialist is arriving at 7pm every Tuesday works differently from one with an open-ended online arrangement. A tutor at the table also sees the things parents report but cannot evidence, such as a student copying worked examples rather than attempting them, or losing focus precisely at the forty-minute mark. Online deserves an honest hearing in three cases. First, scarcity: if the only strong Higher Level Economics or Psychology specialist for your child is in Thane or Navi Mumbai, an IB online tutor in Goregaon East is a better outcome than a nearby generalist, and we say so even though the visit is easier to sell. Second, frequency: a DP2 student in the February crush may need three short clinics a week, which travel makes arithmetically impossible. Third, written feedback: returning an annotated essay works as well on a screen as across a table.

Online is the wrong choice for a Year 9 student who cannot yet work alone, and we repeat that even when it costs us the booking. A thirteen-year-old with a laptop and a chat window produces an agreeable hour and little retained learning. If travel genuinely rules out a visit, the workable compromise is shorter and more frequent sessions with a parent within earshot for the opening ten minutes, not one long unsupervised hour because it fits the calendar better.

Hybrid is where most families here end up by the second term. One longer home visit carries the teaching; one online slot handles marking, a question before a submission, or a lesson that would otherwise be lost to a monsoon evening on JVLR. The home classes we arrange in Mumbai are the anchor, and the online piece is the part that moves when a school trip, a mock timetable or an inter-school event lands in the week. sections.heading: What verification covers, and what you should test yourself
paragraphs: Our checks are documentary and deliberately narrow. Government photo identification seen and matched to the profile name. Qualification checked against the specific subject the tutor intends to teach rather than against teaching in general. Then evidence of recent work at the exact level: which board, which syllabus, which papers, and a precise answer to where students most often lose marks in that subject. The last one does the filtering. A tutor who answers that question with something about confidence has not worked closely enough with the mark scheme to reach a shortlist.

We verify the slot as carefully as the credentials, which matters more in a tower cluster than anywhere else. A tutor stacking three consecutive hours in Oberoi Garden City has a workable week; a tutor holding 6pm in Kandivali West and 7.30pm in Goregaon East does not, and the family in the second slot will blame the teaching when the real problem is the Western Express Highway. Before a profile reaches you, the tutor has confirmed the route, the realistic arrival time and that they can hold the slot for a full term rather than until a nearer booking appears.

Your own questions carry more weight than our documents. Ask which paper or criterion they would start with and why that one. Ask them to describe a student who did not improve and what they changed. Ask what will be set between sessions and how they will know it was attempted. Ask what you will get in writing. And ask directly whether they will speak to the school's subject teacher if you arrange it, because a tutor who avoids that conversation is frequently teaching a method that contradicts the classroom one.

Two things deserve blunt warnings. Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, because the outcome rests with an external examiner and with the student's own work between sessions. And be cautious of anyone who wants months of fees before a lesson has happened. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, does not sell blocks of sessions and holds no notice period. sections.heading: What do IB tuition fees in Goregaon East depend on?
paragraphs: Five variables, and a tower cluster changes two of them. Level comes first: a Higher Level Diploma Programme subject commands more than MYP or Cambridge IGCSE work, because far fewer people teach it properly. Scarcity comes second and moves the number furthest: Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry are widely staffed across Mumbai, while Higher Level Economics, Psychology, a language B or a Group 6 subject can cost noticeably more for no reason beyond how few people can do it well.

Travel is the third variable, and this is where the cluster works in your favour. A tutor who can take two or three consecutive slots in Oberoi Splendor, Oberoi Esquire and Oberoi Exquisite is amortising one journey across three families, and tutors price that more kindly than a single isolated visit across the city. The same logic runs in reverse for an awkward one-off slot at 6pm that requires crossing JVLR in traffic. If the hour is flexible, the number usually improves, which is not true of most Mumbai addresses.

Session length and frequency are the fourth and fifth. Ninety minutes is the common shape for a Higher Level subject because the first twenty go on the previous week's attempts. Two shorter weekly sessions typically cost more in total and teach more, particularly for a DP2 student in February. Pairing two children in the same subject and year lowers the per-family figure, and in this cluster the practical pairing exists in the next tower, but it only works if both students are genuinely at the same point. Pairing a confident student with a struggling one serves neither.

What you are buying is scarce evening hours plus preparation and travel. What you should refuse is an enrolment fee, a prepaid block, or anything sold as a specific grade. Ask three questions rather than requesting a rate card: the hourly figure, the number of weeks to the first written review, and what happens if you stop. Some families call this an IB private tutor Goregaon East arrangement and others call it home tuition; the arithmetic behind it is identical.

sections.heading: What does real progress look like in Goregaon East, Mumbai?
paragraphs: At four weeks, stop looking at grades. Look for four behaviours: a question attempted before it is abandoned, a child who names this week's topic without prompting, homework that happens without negotiation, and a session note from the tutor that names content rather than praising effort. Three of those four at the first review means the arrangement is working even if the most recent assessment is unchanged. A tutor who produces a test score in week four and presents it as evidence is handling the parent rather than teaching the student. Every arrangement of IB Gram home tuition in Goregaon East is judged on those four behaviours at the first review and on marks only later.

At one term, the school's own language should have moved. A DP student's internal or predicted grade shifts, or the subject teacher's comments change from missing content to technique and timing. An MYP student improves on a specific criterion strand rather than in general impression. A Cambridge IGCSE candidate finishes the paper inside the time allowed, which in this corridor is frequently the entire problem rather than a symptom of one. If a full term delivers none of that, the tutor or the diagnosis is wrong, and we change it instead of asking you to persevere.

Across an examination cycle the honest claim is narrow and we will not widen it. Tuition raises what is achievable for a student who turns up, works between sessions and submits internally assessed work on time. It does nothing for a student who treats the weekly hour as the whole of their effort, and no tutor closes a two-year content gap in six weeks. We publish no success rates, because an honest figure would need a control group we do not have, and we do not guarantee grades at any level, in any subject, for any fee.

Changing a tutor is quick and costs nothing. Tell us at a review or between reviews, with or without a reason you can articulate. We ask one or two questions first, because the real fault is sometimes a 6.30pm slot after a long bus journey, or a subject diagnosis that was wrong from the start, and replacing the person fixes neither. If it is the person, you get a fresh shortlist and another free discovery call, and payment to the previous tutor stops from the date you tell us. No notice period, no penalty, no argument.

sections.heading: Starting home tuition in Goregaon East, Mumbai
paragraphs: Three things make the first conversation useful. The latest report including the subject teacher's written comments, not only the grades. A photograph of one recent piece of marked work, ideally a weak one, since a poor paper tells a tutor more in two minutes than a term of good marks. And an honest set of free evenings calculated after the school bus, sport and any sibling's schedule. In a cluster where the bus serves many towers at once, the arrival time home is the real constraint and families routinely underestimate it.

The first session should be mostly diagnostic. Expect the tutor to spend thirty minutes establishing what the current unit is, what the last assessment actually demanded, and where understanding stopped as opposed to where the marks stopped. Expect them to work from the school's materials and real past papers rather than an imported workbook. Expect a written summary afterwards naming the first three topics and the order they will be taken in. If session one is a lecture, raise it at the review rather than waiting for it to improve.

Fix the review date before lesson one begins. Two to four weeks is right: long enough for a pattern to emerge, short enough that a poor match has not swallowed a term. Set it while the tutor is still on the call so nobody treats it as a complaint when it arrives. At that review we want the tutor's note, your observation and, if the child is old enough, their own one-line verdict. A sixteen-year-old saying the sessions are genuinely useful outweighs any formatted report.

Finally, settle access once. Give the tower's front desk the tutor's name and number for standing weekly entry, name the wing and the lift bank, and agree whether the tutor messages on arrival. In a large cluster a visitor can lose ten minutes simply finding the right tower, and that is a sixth of a long lesson. There is no single home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai families need, but there is almost always a right one for this child in this subject, and the logistics are what keep them turning up in February.

sections.heading: Which programmes and levels IB Gram covers in Goregaon West

sections.heading: What happens at the two-week and four-week review?
paragraphs: A short conversation, initiated by us rather than waited for. At two weeks the question is narrow: did the diagnosis happen, and does the parent know what it was. By then the tutor should have watched the child attempt something unaided, read real marked work, and sent a short written account of what they think is wrong and what the next three sessions will cover. If that has not happened, two weeks is the right time to change the profile and almost nothing has been lost.

At four weeks the questions get more useful. Can the child name their own weakness specifically rather than saying they are bad at the subject? Are they bringing their own questions to sessions instead of waiting to be given work? Is working appearing on the page unprompted? Those three are observable from the next room and they predict the report far better than anything in the first month's marks. A grade has not moved yet and should not be expected to, and no honest account of home tuition at four weeks claims otherwise.

After that the cadence settles to roughly every three to four weeks, and the conversation shifts from diagnosis to whether the plan is being followed and whether the practice between sessions is actually happening. That last point is where most arrangements genuinely succeed or fail, and it is a conversation about the household as much as the tutor. A tutor who reports honestly that no practice is being done is more valuable than one who absorbs it quietly and teaches the same thing again.

Changing a tutor is one message at any point in this cycle. Your slot stays where it is, the brief we already hold is updated with what did not work, and a different verified profile goes out, usually within a few days. There is no lock-in, no notice period and no fee for the change. Most replacements happen for reasons unrelated to competence: a personality mismatch, a travel pattern that stopped holding, or a subject need that turned out narrower than the first brief described.

We also will not promise that the first tutor is the right one. Between a quarter and a third of arrangements in any matching service need a change at some point, and pretending otherwise just makes parents reluctant to ask. The commitment we make is about the speed and cost of correction rather than the perfection of the first choice, which is a smaller promise and one that can actually be kept. sections.heading: What IB Gram checks, and what you should check
paragraphs: We verify three things before a profile reaches you. Identity and contact details that belong to a real, reachable person. Claimed teaching experience at the specific programme and level, tested by asking what was taught, where and for how long rather than accepting a list of boards. And travel feasibility against the actual slot you asked for, which on this corridor is the check that matters most, because a tutor who agrees in July to a journey their week cannot hold is the commonest cause of an arrangement collapsing in October.

Those three checks are the whole of what IB Gram home tuition in Govandi guarantees before a name reaches you. What we cannot verify is teaching fit, and we do not pretend to. That is what the free call is for, and the questions that decide it are yours to ask: which level did you teach most recently, how will you find out where marks are being lost, who holds the pen during a session, and what will you show me after four weeks. An IB private tutor Govandi families keep for a full year is usually the one who answered the last question with a marked script and a short list of what remains unresolved, rather than with reassurance.

Two things we will never do are worth stating. We do not write, restructure or supply data for coursework, and we ask tutors to refuse if a family requests it, because the work must be the student's own and schools are required to check authenticity. And we do not promise outcomes: be wary of any service or tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, since nobody who does not mark the paper can promise a number on it. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any school named on this page, and we do not guarantee grades.

sections.heading: What does no lock-in actually mean?
paragraphs: It means you are never holding a contract that makes leaving expensive. There is no minimum term, no package of sessions bought in advance, and no penalty for stopping after a month that did not work. The reason is not generosity; it is that lock-in produces bad matches. A family who has paid for a term will keep attending sessions they privately know are not helping, and a tutor who cannot be replaced has no reason to report a difficulty early. Removing the lock-in makes both sides honest sooner, which is the only mechanism that reliably improves outcomes.

The review is the other half of that. Every two to four weeks there should be a short written note from the tutor saying what was covered, what practice was set and what remains unresolved, and a point at which continuing is a decision rather than a default. Ask for the note in writing even if a conversation feels easier, because a written diagnosis belongs to you rather than to the tutor. If you later change tutor, that note is what lets the replacement start from week four instead of from nothing, and asking for the handover is a reasonable request.

Replacement itself is deliberately undramatic. You tell us what is not working, we ask whether the fix might be a change of method with the same person, and if it is a genuine mismatch we shortlist again from the Chembur and Govandi corridor while you keep your existing slot. Nobody needs to have a difficult conversation with the tutor; that is part of what a platform is for. Changing after a bad month is normal, happens regularly, and costs nothing beyond the time it takes to send the message.

sections.heading: What IB Gram does not promise
paragraphs: We do not guarantee grades, publish success percentages, or quote a rate card. The first because nobody who does not mark the paper can promise a number on it. The second because any figure we published would be unverifiable for your child and would mostly measure which students we happened to work with. The third because IB tuition fees in Govandi genuinely depend on programme, level, subject scarcity, travel distance, session length and whether marking and draft feedback sit inside the fee. Quoting an average would mislead you about the only case you care about.

What we do commit to is more modest and more checkable. A shortlist matched to your brief rather than to our availability. A free call before anything is scheduled. Written notes at a stated interval. A replacement when a match is wrong, without argument. And an honest answer when the answer is unhelpful, including the two we give most often: that the subject you need will take a week longer to staff than you hoped, and that the problem your child has is not the one you rang about. There are also cases where we will tell you not to hire anybody. If your child has no free evening left, adding one makes things worse. If the difficulty is a single topic the class is about to revisit, waiting a fortnight costs nothing. If a student is at Higher Level where Standard Level fits them, the first conversation belongs with the school's coordinator. And if the real issue is sleep, motivation or something happening outside school, tutoring is the wrong instrument and saying so is more useful than taking the booking.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram actually have tutors who travel to Govandi?
faqs.answer: Yes. IB Gram home tuition in Govandi is staffed from the Chembur, Kurla, Mankhurd and Govandi stretch rather than from across Mumbai.
