faqs.question: Is IB Gram a coaching centre or an agency that employs teachers?
faqs.answer: Neither. It is an independent matching platform: you send a brief, we return a short list of verified profiles, and you engage the tutor you choose. There is no centre to attend, no class to join and no fixed curriculum, which is why lessons happen in your own home around your child's school materials. It also means we are not affiliated with any school and do not claim to be. What we take responsibility for is who we put in front of you, the checks behind each profile, and replacing a match that is not working.

faqs.question: What does the free discovery call cover?
faqs.answer: A direct conversation with the tutor, not with a salesperson, before anything is scheduled or paid. Use it to ask which programme and level they taught most recently, how they intend to diagnose rather than assume, who holds the pen in a typical session, and what they will show you after four weeks. It is also when you agree practicalities: session length, whether marking is included, the missed-session rule and the notice period. If the call does not convince you, say so and we shortlist again. A declined shortlist is a normal outcome, not a problem.

faqs.question: Can a tutor come in the evening if both parents work late?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, and this corridor is better placed for it than most because the schooling is one stop away rather than across the city. Workable Govandi slots skew later on weekdays, which suits a household where someone gets home after seven. What we would ask is that an adult is in the flat, that the session happens in a shared space such as the dining table rather than a bedroom, and that somebody is free for five minutes at the end so the tutor can hand over what was covered and what practice is set.

faqs.question: How are IB tuition fees in Govandi set, and why is there no price list?
faqs.answer: Fees are agreed between you and the tutor, and they vary by programme, level, subject scarcity, travel distance, session length and whether marking and draft feedback are included. A published average would be misleading for your particular case, which is the only one that matters. What we do is make the variables explicit so you can compare two quotes properly: ask what a session includes, what happens to a missed one, whether full past-paper marking is inside the fee, and what notice either side needs. Those four answers make quotes comparable.

faqs.question: What if we do not like either of the profiles you send?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we shortlist again, at no cost and with no awkwardness. Sending two or three rather than twenty is deliberate, because a long list transfers the work back to you and most families cannot judge a profile against a syllabus they have not read. The trade-off is that a short list sometimes misses, and a second round is a normal part of the process rather than a failure. If two rounds both miss, the brief is usually the problem and we will ask you different questions.

faqs.question: How often will I hear what is happening in sessions?
faqs.answer: A short written note every few sessions, and a proper review at two to four weeks. The note should say what was covered, what practice was set and what is still unresolved, and it should be short enough to read in two minutes. Ask for it in writing rather than as a chat at the door, because a written record belongs to you and transfers to a new tutor if you change. A tutor who only ever reports that things are going well is not reporting, and the review exists partly to surface that.

faqs.question: Can we pause over the December break or during examinations?
faqs.answer: Yes, and many families on this corridor do. There is no minimum term and no package to use up, so pausing costs nothing beyond losing your slot if the tutor fills it, which is worth checking before you pause in a busy month. Be aware that December is the last long uninterrupted block before a May session, so for a second-year Diploma Programme student a short block of sessions across the break is often more valuable than a full pause. We will say which we think applies and leave the decision with you.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram help with coursework like the Internal Assessment?
faqs.answer: With the thinking and the timeline, not with the writing. A tutor can help choose a workable research question, control the scope, press on how uncertainty or methodology will be handled, and give feedback on a draft the student has written themselves. What a tutor must not do is produce text, restructure an analysis or supply data, because the work has to be the student's own and schools are required to check authenticity. We ask tutors to decline those requests. For current requirements and internal deadlines, your school's coordinator is the source.

faqs.question: Which subjects take longest to staff on this corridor?
faqs.answer: Higher Level Chemistry and Physics, Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches at Higher Level, minority languages, and the more specialised Arts and Design options. Those pools are thin across the whole of Mumbai rather than just the Eastern Suburbs, so a Govandi brief for one of them may take a week or more, and the realistic answers are a weekend block with someone travelling the Eastern Freeway from South Mumbai, or a strong online specialist. Mathematics, the sciences at Standard Level, English and the Individuals and Societies group are usually quick.

faqs.question: Is IB Gram connected to JBCN or Witty in Chembur?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with JBCN International School, Chembur, Witty International School, or any other school in Mumbai. A tutor may have taught students from one of those schools and therefore know how it sequences the course and when it sets internal examinations, which is useful familiarity and nothing more. We name local schools on these pages because that is where children in Govandi, Chembur, Kurla and Mankhurd actually study, and because their calendars decide what a tutor has to prepare for.

faqs.question: Why would an IB tutor in Mumbai be cheaper online than at home?
faqs.answer: Because travel is real work and somebody pays for it. An hour at your dining table in Govandi can cost a tutor two hours of their evening once the journey from Chembur or Kurla is counted, and the fee reflects that. Online removes it entirely, which is why an online specialist often costs less than a nearby home tutor while being equally qualified. The judgement is not financial: in-person supervision is worth paying for when your child will not work unsupervised, and is poor value when they will.

sections.heading: Sending a brief for home tuition in Grant Road
paragraphs: A brief is four lines and it does more work than anything else in the process. Year and programme. Subject and level or tier. School. What is going wrong, in your words. Add a fifth line about the hours you could genuinely offer and you have given us everything needed. The fourth line is the one families under-write: struggling with Physics produces a generalist, while cannot explain why anything happens, only what happens produces a specialist who knows exactly which habit to rebuild.

What follows is fixed. 1. We read the brief and come back with one or two questions, usually about level and about whether an hour you listed is genuinely free. 2. You take a free discovery call with whoever you prefer. 5. IB Gram home tuition in Grant Road begins only once you have said yes to a named person, at a fixed weekly time.

Two or three names is deliberate and occasionally unpopular. A longer list hands the decision back to you with no extra information attached, and the thing a platform can usefully add is judgement: this tutor is stronger on examination technique, this one is better with a child who has stopped trying, this one has taught your exact level but will not take an hour before six. Fifteen profiles with ratings beside them is a directory.

If none of the shortlist fits, we look again rather than letting a near-miss through because a week has gone by. That matters more than it sounds: the cost of unwinding a wrong match in October is a term of a child's year, while the cost of waiting another three days is three days. Most of the regret we hear about across Mumbai comes from matches accepted in a hurry, not from matches that took slightly too long to arrange.

sections.heading: What IB Gram matches for, programme by programme
paragraphs: The International Baccalaureate (IB) across the Primary Years Programme (PYP), the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and the Diploma Programme (DP), plus Cambridge International Education at IGCSE and Pearson Edexcel where a school follows it. Each needs a different kind of tutor, which is why we match on programme rather than on subject alone. A tutor who is excellent with Diploma internal assessments may have no instinct at all for criterion strands in the Middle Years Programme, and the reverse happens just as often.

On the Diploma side we match separately for Higher Level (HL) and Standard Level (SL), because they are not the same request. Higher Level returns to the same material with a longer chain of reasoning expected, and an answer that scored at Standard Level begins losing marks for a missing step. A tutor who has only taught to Standard Level will be competent and leave a Higher Level student short, and the gap shows in a mock rather than a weekly hour. On the Cambridge side, Core or Extended entry changes what should be taught at all.

The Internal Assessment (IA) in each Diploma subject, the Extended Essay (EE) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) are all things we match tutors for, with one boundary that does not move. A tutor can narrow a research question until it is answerable in the weeks available, teach how evidence is used and evaluated, explain what the criteria ask for, and read a draft and point out where a claim is unsupported. A tutor cannot write any part of it and should refuse if asked. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects a tutor in Grant Road is asked for, that line is the same.

Where no verified tutor is free for your subject and level in the window you need, we say so rather than offering an adjacent specialism. Sometimes the answer is a short wait, sometimes online lessons with the right person elsewhere, and occasionally that we cannot help in time. On course structure itself, your school's coordinator and the current subject guide are the authority, because the boards revise them on their own cycles.

sections.heading: Who decides what the sessions cover, you or the tutor?
paragraphs: The tutor, after session one, and this is the part families are most often surprised by. You set the problem and the tutor sets the plan. A parent who arrives with a list of chapters to be covered has usually mistaken tuition for extra school, and the result is an hour spent re-teaching content the school already delivered. The valuable version is the opposite: the tutor spends the first session finding out what is actually broken and then chooses what to work on, including things you did not ask for.

In practice the diagnosis lands in one of a few places, because the failure modes repeat across subjects. In Mathematics, either a student freezes on an unfamiliar question, which is an algebraic fluency and confidence problem taking a term of steady work, or they understand everything and finish nothing, which is a technique problem and often faster to fix. In the sciences, marks go missing on explanation and on investigation design rather than on content. In English and the humanities, the recurring diagnosis is summary where analysis was asked for, or opinion where sourced evidence was required.

Your job after that is to hold the tutor to the plan rather than to write it. Ask at the four-week review whether the diagnosis still stands and what has changed, and push back if the sessions have quietly become homework supervision. That is a reasonable and common intervention, and a good tutor will have noticed it before you do.

Where several subjects need covering we would rather arrange two tutors on lighter schedules than stretch one across four. Related pairs transfer genuinely, Mathematics with Physics, English with History, and we will suggest them where they fit. A home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai parents occasionally ask for does not exist, and a profile claiming the whole curriculum is advertising availability rather than depth.

sections.heading: Why does the Mumbai calendar decide when we can match you?
paragraphs: Because tutors fill their weeks according to it, and the hours vanish in two predictable windows. Children in this pocket attend Bombay International School at Babulnath and Activity High School on Peddar Road, with Aditya Birla World Academy at Tardeo drawing families on both the Diploma Programme and IGCSE routes. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with Bombay International School, Activity High School or any other school named on this page. We name them because their term dates and reporting cycles are the calendar every tutor here schedules around.

The year opens in June and the gentle first weeks are when a Diploma first year quietly slips. The monsoon term brings the first internal assessments and the first candid report, and the fortnight after that report is the first window where everything fills. October and November bring mid-terms. January and February are the heaviest weeks for a Diploma second year, with mocks, internal assessments in final form, the Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge arriving together, and that is the second window.

The advice that follows is simple and almost nobody takes it. Act on one disappointing test in August and you will be choosing between tutors. Wait for the November report and you will be taking whichever hour is still free, which is usually the one the roads make hardest. Home classes in Mumbai get booked on the school calendar, not on impulse, and in a station pocket that is slightly less punishing than elsewhere because the pool is wider, but it still bites.

Two further realities we build in rather than treat as exceptions. Mumbai, Maharashtra loses school days to heavy rain, and the tuition evening usually goes with them, so the make-up rule and the online fallback are both agreed before July. And examination leave empties the school timetable abruptly in spring, which is the natural window for a short intensive block rather than a weekly hour, since a tutor can run longer sessions on consecutive days while nothing competes.

sections.heading: Home classes, online lessons and what we recommend in Mumbai
paragraphs: A tutor in the flat is the default, and any move away from it needs a reason you can state. In the room the tutor sees the working, the hesitation and the wrong line while it is being written, and intervenes before a bad method has been rehearsed for half an hour. That is where most of the value sits for any student below the final Diploma year and for anyone whose attention needs managing, which is why we lead with home tuition rather than video calls with travel as an option.

Online is the right recommendation in three cases and we make it rather than treating it as a fallback. A scarce specialist who cannot reach you even by train, where the correct person on a screen beats a nearby approximation. Short, frequent work in the final months, where twenty minutes on one marked script outperforms a long lesson. And the late hour, where an IB online tutor in Grant Road can teach after nine while a tutor with a return train cannot.

Hybrid suits this pocket particularly well. One in-person lesson at an hour the line supports, plus one short online session for marking and questions at a time nobody could travel for. It buys more contact for the same travel and it keeps the arrangement alive through a disrupted monsoon week. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes in Grant Road settle into some version of that by the second term, whether or not anybody planned it.

Changing mode should be deliberate: tell the tutor, agree the new rhythm, keep the review date. What we discourage is drifting online because one week was difficult, since an in-person habit that lapses for a fortnight rarely returns. Both modes decay in their own way, an in-person hour into supervised homework and an online hour into screen-sharing a textbook, and one question covers both at the end of a session: can your child explain something they could not explain an hour ago?

sections.heading: What IB Gram does, and where the tutor takes over
paragraphs: We do four checks: who the person is, what they hold, which subjects and levels they claim, and whether they have recently taught the board in question. The fourth carries the weight, because subject knowledge is rarely the gap. A strong degree with no exposure to the Diploma Programme produces a tutor who teaches the subject well and the course badly, missing the command terms, the internal assessment criteria and how marks are actually awarded. We also ask every candidate to explain how they would move one named weak student forward, which sorts candidates faster than any document a tutor in Mumbai can produce.

Then we hand over. Once you have said yes, the teaching relationship is between you and the tutor: the plan, the work set, the marking, the day-to-day messages. We stay involved for the review and for a replacement, and we deliberately do not sit in the middle of the teaching, because a platform relaying messages between a parent and a tutor slows everything down and improves nothing. Payment terms are agreed directly with the tutor in writing before the first lesson.

The checks that stay yours are quick and none of them needs subject knowledge. Ask what arrives in writing at four weeks. Ask what the tutor expects your child to do between sessions, because a tutor with no answer plans to explain rather than to teach, and explanation without corrected practice changes very little. Ask what they would refuse to do. And be wary of anybody offering a guaranteed grade or quoting a success rate: boards set grade boundaries each session, no honest tutor promises a number, and IB Gram does not guarantee grades.

One check belongs to the building rather than to either of us alone. Lessons happen inside the flat, so a tutor holding a recurring weekly slot is cleared through your building's visitor procedure before the first visit rather than at the desk on the night, and we confirm how a repeat visitor is handled and whether anything is needed from you each time. It matters more with a commuting tutor, who has no spare margin to lose at a lobby desk after a train journey.

Use it as an interview. Bring the last report, including the comments you would rather not pass on, and one piece of marked work where marks were lost rather than earned. Hand the marked work over and ask the tutor what they see. You are listening for two things: whether they name a concrete teaching move within about thirty seconds, and whether they ask you questions back. A tutor who diagnoses nothing on the call will not diagnose much in session one either.

It is also where you settle the practical matters that otherwise become arguments. The hour and the finishing time, which for a commuting tutor is as important as the start. The trial is the first session, which should be diagnostic rather than instructional and should end with two or three named weaknesses and a plan. If session one looked like chapter one of a textbook, the tutor started teaching because finding the real gap is harder work, and that is worth saying immediately rather than at week four.

sections.heading: No lock-in, no guarantees: what that actually means
paragraphs: No lock-in means there is no joining fee, no minimum number of sessions and no notice period, and that is a design decision rather than a courtesy. A parent who feels committed stays quiet about a poor match for a whole term, and the student loses the term. What we match on is the combination rather than the label. A Primary Years Programme child needs a tutor comfortable with inquiry-led work and with a seven year old's attention span. Whether your child should move from Higher Level to Standard Level, switch a subject, or change tier on a Cambridge course is a school decision, and your coordinator or subject teacher is the authority on both the merits and the deadline. What a tutor can legitimately contribute is a diagnosis of whether the current difficulty is mathematical, linguistic or conceptual, which is often the information the school conversation is missing.

One honest caveat on detail. The IB and the examination boards revise their subject guides on their own cycles, so anything specific about paper arrangements, components or project requirements should be confirmed against the current guide for the year your child actually sits. We brief tutors to say I will check rather than to answer from memory, and a tutor who recites assessment structure confidently from several years ago is a tutor to question.

The jobs online genuinely does better are specific. Draft discussion with a shared document. Data, graph and spreadsheet work, where a value can be changed and the consequence seen immediately. paragraphs: You tell us, we ask one question, and we rematch without charge. The question is what specifically did not work, and it matters because the answer determines the next shortlist entirely. A pace mismatch sends us towards a different teaching manner. A tutor who explained rather than diagnosed sends us towards somebody whose first instinct is to hand over a question. The replacement is drawn from a different part of the pool rather than being the next similar profile on a list. faqs.question: Do you actually serve Hiranandani Gardens, or just advertise it?

faqs.question: How is this different from hiring a tutor through a neighbour's recommendation?
faqs.answer: A neighbour's recommendation tells you the tutor is reliable and pleasant, which is genuinely valuable, and tells you nothing about whether they have taught your child's exact course at your child's exact level. We verify identity, qualifications and teaching history, record cohorts taught per course rather than years of tutoring, and match on the combination. What we cannot replace is the neighbour's knowledge of whether the person turns up, which is why we also ask tutors for references and prefer those already working inside the township.

faqs.question: Will you tell me if my child does not need a tutor?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we do. If the week is already full to the point of exhaustion, adding a weekly session usually makes the rest of the work worse rather than better. If there has been one weak assessment in an otherwise steady year, a conversation with the subject teacher plus the school's own support is cheaper and often enough. If the real difficulty is sleep, motivation or something social, a tutor is the wrong instrument. Saying so costs us a booking and keeps this page worth reading.

faqs.question: Are you connected with Hiranandani Foundation School or Podar International School?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent tutor-matching platform and is not affiliated with Hiranandani Foundation School, Podar International School or any other school named on this page. We mention them because their calendars set the assessment pressure points every tutoring schedule here has to fit around, and because a tutor working inside the township already knows that rhythm. faqs.question: How many profiles will I see, and can I browse more?
faqs.answer: Two or three, and there is no directory to browse, deliberately. A long list pushes parents to choose on price or on a degree, and neither predicts whether a tutor can watch a child work and name the broken step. A short list you can interrogate on a call is more useful. If none of the two or three is right, tell us what did not fit and we send a different set drawn from a different part of the pool rather than the next similar profiles.

faqs.question: What exactly is in the four-week review?
faqs.answer: A named gap in one sentence that you could repeat to the subject teacher, the marked work that evidences it, and a plan for the next few sessions. It should also contain anything outside the tutor's control that they have noticed: work not done between visits, a timetable too full, a difficulty that looks like a school matter rather than an academic one. If a review contains only that your child is improving and more confident, it is not a review, and you should ask for the specific version.

faqs.question: Can one brief cover two children in the same flat?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we prefer it. Many flats in this township hold children on different pathways, one on an IB programme and one on a Cambridge or Pearson Edexcel course, and running two separate searches produces two tutors arriving on the same evening with nobody free on Thursday. One brief records each child's programme, level and subject separately, and we then decide whether the household needs one tutor across consecutive sessions or two people on different days.

faqs.question: Do you offer online tuition, or only tutors who travel to our home?
faqs.answer: Both, with home tuition as the default and online proposed where it does a job better. Online handles draft discussion, data and graph work, reviewing an attempted past paper and language oral practice genuinely well, and it is how a week survives a monsoon stretch when JVLR has stopped moving. For scarce subjects it is also the only way to reach a specialist who lives in Mulund, Chembur or the Western Suburbs. Most families here end up with one home session and one online session a week.

faqs.question: What if we need to pause during the examination season?
faqs.answer: Agree the terms in week one rather than in April. A tutor with several families inside the township has little spare capacity, so a three-week pause is three weeks another family will take, and the arrangement that avoids friction states up front whether a pause holds the slot, releases it, or runs at reduced hours. We have no lock-in contract, so those terms sit between you and the tutor. Putting them in a short message at the start prevents an uncomfortable conversation later.

faqs.question: Will the tutor help with an Internal Assessment or the personal project?
faqs.answer: Within a boundary we brief every tutor on, and it does not move. A tutor may challenge whether the scope is achievable, question whether a method is defensible, insist a process journal is kept as the work goes along, and read one draft against the published criteria. A tutor may not choose the topic, collect or supply data, produce the product, or edit the writing into something the student could not have written. Schools run authenticity checks and the consequence falls on the student.

PYP requests are usually filled within a couple of days, because what the child needs is reading stamina, number confidence and someone who will make them explain their thinking, and the pool of adults who can do that well is large. MYP requests for the core subject groups are usually filled inside a week. Diploma requests at Higher Level in a narrow subject take longer and we will say so rather than filling the slot with a generalist.

We also match for the International General Certificate of Secondary Education, where the first thing we need is the tier your child has been entered for, since Core and Extended candidates sit different papers on different content. Parents frequently do not know the answer, and the examinations officer at the school can confirm it in a sentence. Asking for all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes in Jogeshwari from one tutor is the request we most often have to reshape, because the person who supervises a science investigation is not the person who marks a literature commentary.

What we do not do is advise on programme structure, because that is the school's job and because the International Baccalaureate and the examination boards revise their guides on their own cycles. We will not tell you how a component is weighted, how long a paper is, or what a current mark total is. Ask your school's coordinator or examinations officer, read the current subject guide, and then tell us what they confirmed. We match on that. Any IB private tutor in Jogeshwari we put forward should be working from the same current documents.

When a subject is genuinely scarce we give you three honest options instead of a substitute. A longer journey on a single early-evening slot, which holds if the tutor is committed. An online specialist, which works well for Diploma revision, past paper work and draft feedback. Or a hybrid, with a local tutor on the subject where contact hours matter and the specialist online for the scarce one. A single home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai is not something we will offer, and any service that does is describing a listing rather than a person. paragraphs: Home tutoring is the lead service and the one most families here use, with online and hybrid available where they genuinely suit the child. We will not propose online because it is easier to staff, and if a tutor suggests it for a younger child you should ask why.

Hybrid is where most families here settle by the second month: one session in the room each week plus a shorter online session before a test or a deadline. sections.heading: What happens when something goes wrong
paragraphs: Most problems fall into four types and each has a different response. A stage or level mismatch, where the tutor is good but pitched wrong, needs a different specialist and we shortlist again inside the week. A clash of style, where a capable tutor and your child simply do not work together, needs a different personality rather than better qualifications. Repeated lateness or cancellation needs someone whose route already passes your building, which in Jogeshwari usually means tutors working the Andheri East to Powai run. And no visible progress after four weeks needs a conversation before it needs a replacement.

That fourth case is the one worth slowing down on. Before changing anybody, check what no progress means. If the tutor can name the weak topics and the written work is better structured even though marks have not moved, the arrangement is working and marks follow a term later. If nobody can name a weak topic after four sessions, the tutor has been going through a textbook and the match has failed. The four-week review exists to force that question, and we ask it rather than waiting for a parent to raise it.

There is no notice period, no package to finish and no penalty for stopping, and that is the whole design. A service that locks parents in has no incentive to tell them when a match is wrong. We would rather lose a booking at week four than hold one for a term that does nothing, and we will occasionally tell you that your child does not need a tutor at all: that the real issue is subject load, reading volume or a timetable with nothing left in it. IB Gram home tutors in Jogeshwari are worth paying for when there is something a tutor can change, and no amount of home tuition in Mumbai substitutes for an hour of sleep.

sections.heading: Which programmes and boards does IB Gram cover in Juhu?
paragraphs: The International Baccalaureate (IB) continuum and the Cambridge pathway, which between them covers almost every family in this corridor. On the IB side that means the Primary Years Programme (PYP), the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and the Diploma Programme (DP), including Higher Level (HL) and Standard Level (SL) subjects and the internal assessments attached to them. On the Cambridge side it means the lower secondary years through to the IGCSE examinations, including Core and Extended tier entries, along with Pearson Edexcel where a school follows it.

Depth is not uniform across all of that, and pretending otherwise would waste your time. The strongest supply is in mathematics, the three sciences, English, economics and business at both Diploma and IGCSE level. MYP support across the subject groups is readily available. PYP support is genuinely available but thinner, because fewer qualified teachers across Mumbai do private work with primary-age children. Languages other than English, Hindi and French are the hardest requests to fill.

Households in Juhu quite often need two arrangements at once, and that is worth planning deliberately rather than discovering gradually. Because the local schools run the full continuum, one family can have a PYP child whose teacher has flagged reading and a Diploma sibling drafting an internal assessment, which is two completely different tutors on two different evenings. We would rather set that up as two matches from the start than stretch one adult across both and watch the weaker half fail.

Where we cannot help, we say so rather than improvising. Requests for competitive examination coaching, for state board syllabi, or for subjects where we have no verified teacher at the right level all get a direct answer. A platform that says yes to everything will eventually put somebody unsuitable in your home, and the cost of that is a wasted term rather than a wasted call. IB home tuition in Juhu is only worth arranging when the match is real.

sections.heading: Which subjects can we actually staff in Juhu?

Diploma internal assessments need somebody who has supervised that specific piece of coursework and knows where the academic honesty line sits. Examination technique needs somebody who marks like an examiner. A conceptual gap needs a patient explainer. These are three different people anywhere in Mumbai, and the brief should say which you want.

Within mathematics the route matters and parents often do not know which one their child is on. Analysis and Approaches and Applications and Interpretation reward different skills and are assessed differently, so a tutor strong in one is not automatically useful for the other. Within the sciences, the individual investigation is a substantial piece of work in each subject and the supervision skill is subject-specific. Within languages, literature and language acquisition are separate disciplines with separate assessment structures.

On the Cambridge side the tier decision shapes everything. A Core candidate and an Extended candidate in the same subject are sitting different papers with different grade ceilings, and tuition should be built around which one your child is actually entered for rather than which one you hope for. If you are unsure, the school office can confirm it in one email, and it is worth doing before the first session rather than after the third.

No single tutor covers them all, and a tutor who claims to is offering availability rather than expertise. Where a family needs three subjects, the realistic shape is one specialist for the hardest one and lighter support, often online, for the others.

sections.heading: How IB Gram home tuition in Juhu is scheduled around the traffic
paragraphs: Juhu sits on the Juhu-JVPD corridor with Vile Parle and Santacruz as its nearest stations, and the practical catchment for a weekday evening slot is four pockets: Juhu, JVPD Scheme, Vile Parle West and Khar West. We build the shortlist from inside that band first, every time, because a tutor who travels fifteen minutes will still be arriving on time in March and a tutor who travels an hour will have renegotiated the slot twice by then.

The Western Suburbs run north to south along the Western Express Highway and the Western Line, so a tutor travelling Bandra to Andheri is quick off-peak and painful at six in the evening. Matching along the line, Khar to Santacruz or Malad to Kandivali, works far better than matching across it. This is the single geographic fact in Mumbai, Maharashtra that decides whether an arrangement lasts a term, and it is why we ask for your available evenings before we search rather than after.

Slot design follows from that. A seven o'clock start works for a tutor coming from JVPD Scheme or Vile Parle West, where entry is quick. Khar West tutors usually prefer eight, because the Linking Road crawl in the evening peak makes an earlier arrival unreliable. A Saturday or Sunday morning block opens the field considerably and is the right answer for a scarce subject, because weekend traffic makes a tutor from Andheri or Bandra genuinely viable.

When the band cannot supply what you need, you get the real options rather than an optimistic match. A longer travel time with a later start. A weekend block. Or an online arrangement with somebody who has taught exactly that level, possibly combined with occasional home sessions. Parents searching for IB tutors near me in Juhu are right that distance matters; what we add is the judgement about when distance should be traded for expertise and when it should not.

paragraphs: Yes, and we will tell you which one we think your request needs rather than selling the one that is easier to arrange. An IB Gram home tutor in Juhu sees whether a plan was written, whether the question was read twice, whether the diagram was drawn. That is the diagnostic value you are paying for early on.

Online becomes the better option in specific, identifiable situations. When the subject and level combination is scarce enough that nobody suitable lives within reach. When the student has become independent and needs work marked rather than taught. When the family's schedule has become unpredictable enough that a fixed home slot keeps getting cancelled. An IB online tutor in Juhu is not a downgrade in those cases; it is the arrangement more likely to survive.

Hybrid is what most of our Juhu families are doing by the second term, and we now propose it openly rather than waiting for parents to ask. What we will not do is switch an arrangement to online without telling you why. sections.heading: What IB Gram checks, and what we cannot check for you
paragraphs: Before a profile reaches you, we check identity documents and qualifications, we have a specific conversation about the programme, subject and level the tutor claims to have taught, and we collect references where they exist. A tutor who cannot produce documents does not get a profile. A tutor whose claimed teaching experience does not survive a detailed subject conversation does not get one either, and that second filter removes more applicants than the first.

What verification cannot establish is fit, and we are direct about that limit. Whether a particular adult will work well with your particular fourteen-year-old is not a documentable quality. That is the entire purpose of the free discovery call, and it is why we encourage parents to put the child on the call for a few minutes rather than deciding on their behalf. A tutor who is wonderful with a driven Higher Level student can be wrong for one who has lost confidence.

There are two checks only you can do, and they matter. Sit in on part of the first session, or leave the door open, and listen for whether the tutor asks questions and waits for answers or talks continuously. Then look at your child's exercise book after two weeks: if the written work has not changed shape, the hours are going into conversation rather than practice. Both checks take ten minutes and catch most problems early.

We also tell parents what we do not verify. We do not test tutors ourselves with a subject examination, we do not audit their teaching in your home, and we do not have access to any school's internal assessment of a student's progress. Any tutoring platform in Mumbai claiming more than that is overstating what is possible. What we provide is a filtered shortlist, a structured review, and a straightforward replacement process when a match is wrong.

sections.heading: What IB Gram does not do, stated plainly
paragraphs: We do not guarantee grades, publish success rates or quote improvement figures. A tutor controls diagnosis, practice and feedback. Nobody controls the paper a student sits in May, the marking of it, or whether a teenager does the work set between sessions. Any platform in Mumbai quoting a proportion of students who improved is describing a number nobody can audit, and we would rather be the service that explains what fees depend on than the one that invents a statistic.

We do not write or improve coursework. Diploma internal assessments, Extended Essays, Middle Years personal projects and IGCSE coursework must be the student's own work under academic honesty rules, and a tutor's legitimate role is to teach the skills: narrowing a research question, planning data collection, processing results, writing an honest evaluation. A tutor who offers to draft a section or choose a topic is creating a risk that falls entirely on your child, and we remove tutors who do it.

We do not lock families in. There is no minimum term, no package of sessions bought in advance, and no penalty for stopping. We ask for a review conversation at two to four weeks because that is when evidence first becomes visible, not because stopping requires permission. We also do not operate a loyalty discount structure that makes it awkward to change tutor, because that quietly discourages exactly the conversation a struggling family most needs to have.

And we do not claim any relationship with schools. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any school named on this site, and no tutor on our list should be presented to your building or to a teacher as having one. Where a family wants us to speak to a school, the honest answer is that the school has no obligation to speak to us and the useful conversation is between the parent and the coordinator.

sections.heading: The two to four week review and what happens if it goes badly
paragraphs: At two to four weeks we ask you three questions. Can the tutor state your child's specific weakness in one sentence. Can your child describe something similar in their own words. Has the written work changed shape, meaning more working shown, a plan before an essay, units carried through a calculation. Those three answers tell you whether the arrangement is working well before any mark moves, which is the point of reviewing early rather than waiting for a report.

If the answers are no, the next step is a conversation rather than more hours. Competence plus no progress usually means one of three things: the diagnosis was wrong, the between-session work is not being done, or the temperament pairing is off. The first two are fixable with the same tutor. Only the third needs a replacement. Buying extra sessions before working out which of the three applies is the most common and most expensive mistake we see families across Mumbai make.

Replacement itself is undramatic. Tell us what is not working in whatever words you have, and a different profile usually follows within a few days, with the same free discovery call before anything is scheduled. You are not asked to justify the decision and the outgoing tutor is not told anything beyond the fact that the arrangement has ended. Most mismatches are temperament rather than knowledge, and nobody involved needs to treat it as a failure.

Over a longer horizon the honest picture is real improvement for a student who does the work between sessions and limited improvement for one who does not.
